title: Counter-UAS & Base Defense
attribution: Mokuhyo contributors. English definitions: US Government works (public domain) — DoD Dictionary, ATP 3-01.81, JP 3-10, JP 3-01, ATP 1-02.1 — or original where marked. Target-language terms aligned with the allied sources cited per term; definitions, examples and dialogues AI-drafted with Mistral-Small-3.2-24B, pending human review.

terms.definitionEn: That system of equipment, network, and personnel to control an unmanned aircraft. Also called UAS.
terms.definition: 无人机系统是指控制无人飞行器的设备、网络和人员组成的系统。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 无人机系统已准备好执行侦察任务。
examples.english: The unmanned aircraft system is ready to perform reconnaissance mission.

examples.text: 无人机系统成功完成了目标区域的巡逻。
examples.english: The unmanned aircraft system successfully completed the patrol of the target area.

terms.definitionEn: An aircraft that does not carry a human operator and is capable of flight with or without human remote control. Also called UA.
terms.definition: 无人机是一种不载人操作员的飞行器，可以在有人远程控制或无人控制下飞行。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 无人机正在进行空中侦察。
examples.english: The unmanned aircraft is conducting aerial reconnaissance.

examples.text: 无人机已返回基地。
examples.english: The unmanned aircraft has returned to base.

terms.definitionEn: An unmanned aircraft system whose aircraft weighs less than 55 pounds, together with its ground control station and data links.
terms.definition: 小型无人机系统是指飞行器重量不超过55磅，并包括其地面控制站和数据链接的无人机系统。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 小型无人机系统可用于快速响应任务。
examples.english: Small unmanned aircraft systems can be used for rapid response missions.

examples.text: 小型无人机系统已部署完成。
examples.english: The small unmanned aircraft system deployment is complete.

terms.definitionEn: One of five size classes the US military uses for unmanned aircraft, from Group 1 (under 20 pounds, low and slow) to Group 5 (over 1,320 pounds, flying above 18,000 feet).
terms.definition: 无人机组是指美国军方用于分类无人飞行器的五个尺寸类别，从1组（低于20磅，低速）到5组（超过1,320磅，飞行高度超过18,000英尺）。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 无人机组已经进入目标区域。
examples.english: The UAS group has entered the target area.

examples.text: 无人机组正在执行任务。
examples.english: The UAS group is executing the mission.

terms.definitionEn: A small drone flown by an operator who watches a live video feed from its onboard camera, often through goggles, and often used as a guided explosive weapon.
terms.definition: 一人机是一种小型无人机，操作员通过观看其机载摄像头的实时视频流进行控制，通常用于引导爆炸性武器。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 一人机正在进行实时视频传输。
examples.english: The first-person-view drone is transmitting live video.

examples.text: 一人机已锁定目标。
examples.english: The first-person-view drone has locked onto the target.

terms.definitionEn: Loitering munition is a reference to any UAS that can engage beyond line-of-sight ground targets with an explosive warhead or lethal payload to cause injury via a “suicide mode” attack. 1-8.
terms.definition: 侦察打击无人机是指能够在视线之外的地面目标上方盘旋并携带爆炸性弹头或致命载荷的无人机系统，可通过“自杀模式”攻击造成伤害。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 侦察打击无人机已发现敌方目标。
examples.english: The loitering munition has detected enemy targets.

examples.text: 侦察打击无人机已锁定目标并准备攻击。
examples.english: The loitering munition has locked onto the target and is preparing to attack.

terms.definitionEn: A group of unmanned aircraft that operate together under coordinated or automated control to overwhelm defenses or complete a shared task.
terms.definition: 无人机群是指在协调或自动控制下共同行动的多架无人飞行器组成的群体，用于压制防御或完成共同任务。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 无人机群正在进行协同作战演练。
examples.english: The drone swarm is conducting coordinated combat exercises.

examples.text: 无人机群已成功完成任务。
examples.english: The drone swarm has successfully completed the mission.

terms.definitionEn: An aircraft that gets lift from wings that do not move, so it must keep moving forward to stay in the air.
terms.definition: 固定翼无人机是一种依靠不移动的机翼获得升力的飞行器，必须持续向前飞行以保持空中状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 固定翼无人机正在执行长时间侦察任务。
examples.english: The fixed-wing unmanned aircraft is performing a long-duration reconnaissance mission.

examples.text: 固定翼无人机已返回基地。
examples.english: The fixed-wing unmanned aircraft has returned to base.

terms.definitionEn: An aircraft that gets lift from spinning rotor blades, so it can take off vertically and hover.
terms.definition: 旋翼无人机是一种依靠旋转的旋翼获得升力的飞行器，可以垂直起飞和悬停。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 旋翼无人机正在进行低空侦察。
examples.english: The rotary-wing unmanned aircraft is conducting low-altitude reconnaissance.

examples.text: 旋翼无人机已锁定目标。
examples.english: The rotary-wing unmanned aircraft has locked onto the target.

terms.definitionEn: A drone lifted by several horizontal propellers (commonly four, six or eight) that lets it hover and change direction quickly.
terms.definition: 多旋翼无人机是一种由多个水平螺旋桨提供升力的无人机，通常有四、六或八个螺旋桨，使其能够快速悬停和改变方向。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 多旋翼无人机正在进行快速响应任务。
examples.english: The multirotor drone is performing a rapid response mission.

examples.text: 多旋翼无人机已返回基地。
examples.english: The multirotor drone has returned to base.

terms.definitionEn: The equipment, people and procedures used to detect, track, identify and defeat hostile or unauthorized unmanned aircraft.
terms.definition: 反无人机系统是指用于检测、跟踪、识别并击败敌对或未经授权无人机的设备、人员和程序。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical and operational contexts, both radio and written.

examples.text: 反无人机系统已部署完毕，准备进行测试。
examples.english: The counter-unmanned aircraft system has been deployed and is ready for testing.

examples.text: 监测到无人机活动，立即启动反无人机系统。
examples.english: Unmanned aircraft activity detected, activate the counter-unmanned aircraft system immediately.

terms.definitionEn: A defense that places several sensors and weapons at different ranges so that a threat that gets past one layer can still be stopped by the next.
terms.definition: 分层防御是指在不同距离上部署多个传感器和武器，以便威胁穿过一个层级时仍能被下一个层级阻止。
terms.registerNote: Common in strategic planning and briefings, both radio and written.

examples.text: 分层防御体系可有效提高防空能力。
examples.english: The layered defense system can effectively enhance air defense capabilities.

examples.text: 该防御系统采用分层防御策略，确保全方位防护。
examples.english: The defense system employs a layered defense strategy, ensuring all-round protection.

terms.definitionEn: In counter-UAS, the first step: sensing that an aircraft or drone is present, by radar, radio-frequency, optical or acoustic sensors.
terms.definition: 探测是指在反无人机作战中，通过雷达、射频、光学或声学传感器感知无人机或无人机的存在。
terms.registerNote: Used in operational contexts, often in real-time radio communication.

examples.text: 感知到无人机信号，正在进行探测。
examples.english: Unmanned aircraft signal detected, conducting detection.

examples.text: 探测结果显示有多架无人机接近。
examples.english: Detection results show multiple unmanned aircraft approaching.

terms.definitionEn: Precise and continuous position-finding of targets by radar, optical, or other means.
terms.definition: 跟踪是指通过雷达、光学或其他手段对目标进行精确且连续的位置确定。
terms.registerNote: Common in operational contexts, both radio and written.

examples.text: 目标已被锁定，正在进行跟踪。
examples.english: Target locked, conducting tracking.

examples.text: 跟踪数据显示无人机正在改变航向。
examples.english: Tracking data shows the unmanned aircraft is changing course.

terms.definitionEn: 1. The process of determining the friendly or hostile character of an unknown detected contact. 2. In arms control, the process of determining which nation is responsible for the detected violations of any arms control measure. 3. In ground combat operations, discrimination between recognizable objects as being friendly or enemy, or the name that belongs to the object as a member of a class. Also called ID.
terms.definition: 识别是指确定未知接触的友好或敌对性质的过程。
terms.registerNote: Used in operational and technical contexts, both radio and written.

examples.text: 正在进行识别，确认目标性质。
examples.english: Conducting identification, confirming target nature.

examples.text: 识别结果显示该无人机为敌方。
examples.english: Identification results show the unmanned aircraft is hostile.

terms.definitionEn: In counter-UAS, the step that stops an unmanned aircraft from completing its mission, by destroying it, disabling it or taking control of it.
terms.definition: 无人机打击是指通过摧毁、使其失效或控制无人机来阻止其完成任务的步骤。
terms.registerNote: Common in operational contexts, both radio and written.

examples.text: 收到命令，准备进行无人机打击。
examples.english: Received order, preparing for unmanned aircraft defeat.

examples.text: 无人机打击已完成，目标已被消灭。
examples.english: Unmanned aircraft defeat completed, target eliminated.

terms.definitionEn: Stopping an unmanned aircraft by physically hitting it, for example with gunfire, a missile, an interceptor drone or a net.
terms.definition: 运动打击是指通过物理击中无人机来阻止其行动，例如使用枪火、导弹、拦截无人机或网络。
terms.registerNote: Used in operational contexts, often in real-time radio communication.

examples.text: 收到授权，进行运动打击。
examples.english: Authorization received, conducting kinetic defeat.

examples.text: 运动打击已成功，无人机被击落。
examples.english: Kinetic defeat successful, unmanned aircraft shot down.

terms.definitionEn: Stopping an unmanned aircraft without physically hitting it, for example by jamming its control link or its satellite navigation.
terms.definition: 非运动打击是指通过干扰无人机的控制链或卫星导航等方式，而不直接击中无人机来阻止其行动。
terms.registerNote: Common in technical and operational contexts, both radio and written.

examples.text: 启动非运动打击程序，切断无人机控制。
examples.english: Initiating non-kinetic defeat procedure, severing unmanned aircraft control.

examples.text: 非运动打击已生效，无人机失去控制。
examples.english: Non-kinetic defeat effective, unmanned aircraft lost control.

terms.definitionEn: Finding a drone by picking up the radio signals passing between it and its controller, which can also point to where the operator is.
terms.definition: 射频探测是指通过捕捉无人机与其控制器之间的无线电信号来发现无人机，这些信号也能指示操作者的位置。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical and operational contexts, both radio and written.

examples.text: 射频探测系统已捕捉到无人机信号。
examples.english: Radio-frequency detection system has captured unmanned aircraft signal.

examples.text: 射频探测显示操控者位于东北方向。
examples.english: Radio-frequency detection shows the operator is in the northeast direction.

terms.definitionEn: A sensor that sends out radio waves and measures their echoes to find the position, speed and direction of objects such as aircraft.
terms.definition: 雷达是一种通过发射无线电波并测量回波来确定飞机等物体的位置、速度和方向的传感器。
terms.registerNote: Common in operational contexts, both radio and written.

examples.text: 雷达已发现可疑目标，正在跟踪。
examples.english: Radar has detected a suspicious target, tracking.

examples.text: 雷达数据显示有多个目标接近。
examples.english: Radar data shows multiple targets approaching.

terms.definitionEn: A camera system that uses visible light and heat images to see, follow and identify a target by day or night.
terms.definition: 电光/红外传感器是一种摄像系统，它利用可见光和热成像在白天或夜晚观察、跟踪和识别目标。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports for target acquisition.

examples.text: 电光/红外传感器已锁定目标，请求授权攻击
examples.english: EO/IR sensor has locked the target, requesting permission to engage

examples.text: 电光/红外传感器正在跟踪敌方无人机
examples.english: EO/IR sensor is tracking the enemy drone

terms.definitionEn: A sensor that detects a drone by listening for the sound of its motors and propellers.
terms.definition: 声学传感器通过监听无人机的马达和螺旋桨的声音来探测无人机。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports for target detection.

examples.text: 声学传感器检测到可疑声音，请求支援
examples.english: Acoustic sensor detected suspicious sound, requesting backup

examples.text: 声学传感器正在监测无人机引擎声音
examples.english: Acoustic sensor is monitoring drone engine sounds

terms.definitionEn: The employment of limited offensive action and counterattacks to deny a contested area or position to the enemy.
terms.definition: 主动防御是指通过有限的进攻行动和反击来阻止敌人占领争夺区域或位置。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports for defensive operations.

examples.text: 我们将采取主动防御措施，阻止敌方无人机入侵
examples.english: We will employ active defense measures to prevent enemy drone intrusion

examples.text: 主动防御系统已启动，准备反击
examples.english: Active defense system activated, ready to counterattack

terms.definitionEn: Measures taken to reduce the probability of and to minimize the effects of damage caused by hostile action without the intention of taking the initiative.
terms.definition: 被动防御是采取措施减少敌方攻击造成的损害概率和影响，而不主动采取行动。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports for defensive preparations.

examples.text: 被动防御措施已就位，待命中
examples.english: Passive defense measures in place, awaiting orders

examples.text: 被动防御系统正在运行，监测敌方动向
examples.english: Passive defense system operational, monitoring enemy movements

terms.definitionEn: The deliberate radiation, reradiation, or reflection of electromagnetic energy for the purpose of preventing or reducing the effective use of the electromagnetic spectrum, with the intent of degrading or disrupting combat capability.
terms.definition: 电磁干扰是故意辐射、重新辐射或反射电磁能量，以防止或减少敌方有效使用电磁频谱，从而降低或破坏作战能力。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports for electronic warfare.

examples.text: 开始电磁干扰，干扰敌方通信
examples.english: Initiating electromagnetic jamming, disrupting enemy communications

examples.text: 电磁干扰设备已准备就绪，等待命令
examples.english: Electromagnetic jamming equipment ready, awaiting orders

terms.definitionEn: Sending false signals, such as fake satellite navigation data, so that a drone or receiver believes it is somewhere it is not.
terms.definition: 欺骗是通过发送虚假信号，如伪造的卫星导航数据，使无人机或接收器误以为自己在错误的位置。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports for electronic countermeasures.

examples.text: 检测到欺骗信号，无人机可能被误导
examples.english: Spoofing signals detected, drone may be misled

examples.text: 欺骗设备已启动，发送虚假导航数据
examples.english: Spoofing equipment activated, sending false navigation data

terms.definitionEn: Actions taken to maintain friendly use of positioning, navigation, and timing information while denying the same to an adversary. Also called NAVWAR.
terms.definition: 导航战是指保持友方对定位、导航和时间信息的使用，同时阻止敌方获得相同信息的行动。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports for electronic warfare operations.

examples.text: 导航战小组已就位，准备执行任务
examples.english: NAVWAR team in position, ready to execute mission

examples.text: 导航战措施已启动，保护我们的定位系统
examples.english: NAVWAR measures activated, protecting our positioning system

terms.definitionEn: The production of a beam of concentrated electromagnetic energy or atomic or subatomic particles. Also called DE.
terms.definition: 定向能是指产生一束集中的电磁能量或原子或亚原子粒子。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports for weapon systems.

examples.text: 定向能武器系统已锁定目标
examples.english: Directed energy weapon system has locked the target

examples.text: 定向能武器准备发射，请求授权
examples.english: Directed energy weapon ready to fire, requesting permission

terms.definitionEn: A weapon or system that uses directed energy to incapacitate, damage, or destroy enemy equipment, facilities, and/or personnel.
terms.definition: 定向能武器是一种利用定向能量来使敌方设备、设施和/或人员失效、受损或被摧毁的武器或系统。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports for weapon engagement.

examples.text: 定向能武器已击中敌方无人机
examples.english: Directed-energy weapon has hit the enemy drone

examples.text: 定向能武器系统正在充电，准备再次攻击
examples.english: Directed energy weapon system charging, ready to engage again

terms.definitionEn: A drone launched to chase and destroy or capture a hostile drone in the air.
terms.definition: 截击无人机是指发射无人机追踪并摧毁或捕获敌方无人机。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports for drone operations.

examples.text: 截击无人机已起飞，正在追踪敌方目标
examples.english: Interceptor drone airborne, tracking enemy target

examples.text: 截击无人机已锁定目标，请求授权攻击
examples.english: Interceptor drone has locked the target, requesting permission to engage

terms.definitionEn: Defeating a small drone by catching it in a net fired from the ground or carried by another drone.
terms.definition: 通过从地面发射或由其他无人机携带的网捕捉小型无人机
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings, both written and radio.

examples.text: 目标无人机已被网捕系统成功拦截并缴获
examples.english: The target drone has been successfully intercepted and captured by the net capture system

examples.text: 网捕无人机是应对小型无人机威胁的有效手段
examples.english: Net capture is an effective countermeasure against small drone threats

terms.definitionEn: The radio connection over which an operator sends commands to an unmanned aircraft and receives its status.
terms.definition: 操作员通过无线电连接向无人机发送指令并接收其状态的通信链路
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 指挥控制链中断，无人机进入应急模式
examples.english: The command and control link is interrupted, and the drone has entered emergency mode

examples.text: 需要立即修复指挥控制链以恢复对无人机的控制
examples.english: The command and control link needs to be repaired immediately to restore control of the drone

terms.definitionEn: A radio connection that passes data, such as video, position and commands, between an aircraft and the ground or other units.
terms.definition: 在无人机与地面或其他单位之间传输数据（如视频、位置和指令）的无线电连接
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and radio communication.

examples.text: 数据链路稳定，视频传输清晰
examples.english: The data link is stable, and the video transmission is clear

examples.text: 确保数据链路安全以防止数据泄露
examples.english: Ensure the data link is secure to prevent data leakage

terms.definitionEn: A range of radio frequencies; many small drones use the 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz bands for control and video.
terms.definition: 一组无线电频率，许多小型无人机使用2.4 GHz和5.8 GHz频段进行控制和视频传输
terms.registerNote: Used in technical and operational contexts, formal, radio and written.

examples.text: 我们需要确定无人机使用的频段以进行干扰。
examples.english: We need to determine the frequency band used by the drone for jamming.

examples.text: 该频段内的通信信号非常微弱。
examples.english: The communication signals in this frequency band are very weak.

terms.definitionEn: A drone's broadcast of its identity, location and the location of its control station, which receivers on the ground can read.
terms.definition: 无人机通过广播其身份、位置和控制站的位置，地面接收器可以读取这些信息
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and liaison communication.

examples.text: 远程识别信号显示无人机当前位置
examples.english: The remote identification signal shows the current location of the drone

examples.text: 通过远程识别信息追踪无人机操作员位置
examples.english: Track the drone operator's location using remote identification information

terms.definitionEn: The place from which a person is controlling a drone; finding it lets security forces stop the threat at its source.
terms.definition: 控制无人机的人所在的位置，找到它可以让安保部队阻止威胁源头
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 无人机操作员位置已确定，请求支援部队前往拦截
examples.english: The drone operator's location has been determined; request support units to intercept

examples.text: 无人机操作员位置可能隐藏在人群密集区
examples.english: The drone operator's location may be hidden in densely populated areas

collocations: 确定无人机操作员位置
无人机操作员位置追踪
无人机操作员位置确认

terms.definitionEn: The place from which an unmanned aircraft takes off.
terms.definition: 无人机起飞的地点
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 发射点已被发现，请求立即清除
examples.english: The launch point has been discovered; request immediate clearance

examples.text: 无人机发射点可能位于多个位置
examples.english: The drone launch point may be in multiple locations

terms.definitionEn: The place where an unmanned aircraft is planned to land or be collected after its flight.
terms.definition: 无人机计划降落或在飞行后被收集的地点
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 收容点已设置，无人机将在该区域降落
examples.english: The recovery point has been set up, and the drone will land in that area

examples.text: 需要确保收容点安全以便无人机回收
examples.english: Ensure the recovery point is secure for drone retrieval

terms.definitionEn: The planned or observed path of an aircraft in altitude, speed and direction over time.
terms.definition: 无人机在高度、速度和方向上随时间变化的预定或观测到的路径
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and briefings.

examples.text: 飞行路线已规划，无人机将按照预定路径飞行
examples.english: The flight profile has been planned, and the drone will fly along the predetermined path

examples.text: 监控无人机飞行路线以确保其不偏离
examples.english: Monitor the drone's flight profile to ensure it does not deviate

terms.definitionEn: To stay over or near an area for a period of time, for example to watch it or to wait for a target.
terms.definition: 在某个区域上方或附近停留一段时间，例如观察或等待目标
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 无人机在目标上空盘旋，等待进一步指令
examples.english: The drone is loitering above the target, awaiting further instructions

examples.text: 盘旋高度为500米，持续时间为10分钟
examples.english: Loitering at an altitude of 500 meters for a duration of 10 minutes

terms.definitionEn: The movement of an aircraft into an area toward its target or objective.
terms.definition: 飞机向目标或目标区域移动的过程。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 飞机正在进入目标区域，请各单位注意配合。
examples.english: Aircraft are ingressing the target area, all units please cooperate.

examples.text: 目标区域已被锁定，允许进入。
examples.english: The target area has been locked, ingress permitted.

terms.definitionEn: The movement of an aircraft out of a target area after completing its task.
terms.definition: 飞机在完成任务后离开目标区域的过程。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 任务完成，飞机即将离开目标区域。
examples.english: Task complete, aircraft egressing the target area.

examples.text: 离开区域后，请汇报情况。
examples.english: Report situation after egressing the area.

terms.definitionEn: An attack by many aircraft, drones or missiles arriving at the same time to overload the defenses.
terms.definition: 许多飞机、无人机或导弹同时到达目标区域进行攻击，以压倒防御系统。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, radio communications, and reports, indicating a high threat level.

examples.text: 敵方發動集群打擊，請立即啟動防禦系統。
examples.english: Enemy is launching a mass raid, activate defense systems immediately.

examples.text: 集群打擊來襲，所有單位保持高度戒備。
examples.english: Mass raid incoming, all units maintain high alert.

terms.definitionEn: The point at which more threats arrive than the defense can detect, track or engage at once.
terms.definition: 防御系统无法同时探测、跟踪或攻击所有到达的威胁的状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 敌方导弹正在接近，武器使用区域内即将达到饱和状态。
examples.english: Enemy missiles approaching, saturation imminent in the WEZ.

examples.text: 饱和状态下，各单位请保持警惕。
examples.english: Under saturation, all units remain vigilant.

terms.definitionEn: A form of collateral effect that causes unintentional or incidental injury or damage to persons or objects that would not be lawful military targets in the circumstances ruling at the time.
terms.definition: 在军事行动中，无意中对非法军事目标的人员或物体造成的伤害或损失。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 空袭可能会造成附带损害，请平民迅速撤离。
examples.english: Airstrike may cause collateral damage, civilians evacuate immediately.

examples.text: 附带损害评估报告已提交。
examples.english: Collateral damage assessment report submitted.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which a particular weapon system engages air and missile threats. Also called WEZ.
terms.definition: 一个特定的武器系统用来对付空中和导弹威胁的定义空域。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 武器控制状态已设定为自由射击，可自由攻击敌方目标。
examples.english: Weapons control status set to weapons free, engage enemy targets at will.

examples.text: 在武器控制状态下，各单位请严格遵守规则。
examples.english: Under weapons control status, all units strictly follow rules.

terms.definitionEn: An air and missile defense control measure declared for a particular area and time by an area air defense commander, or delegated subordinate commander, based on the rules of engagement that establish the conditions under which fighters and surface air defense weapons are permitted to engage threats. Also call WCS.
terms.definition: 区域防空指挥官或授权下属指挥官根据作战规则设定的，在特定区域和时间内，战斗机和地面防空武器可以攻击威胁的条件。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports, indicating specific control measures.

examples.text: 武器控制狀態為紅色，禁止所有非授權發射。
examples.english: Weapons control status is red, prohibit all unauthorized launches.

examples.text: 根據武器控制狀態調整防禦策略，確保安全。
examples.english: Adjust defense strategies based on weapons control status to ensure safety.

terms.definitionEn: Weapons free is the least restrictive status: used to indicate when any target not positively identified as friendly in accordance with current ROE may be engaged.
terms.definition: 任何未被明确识别为友军的目标都可以被攻击的最不受限的状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 根据当前规则，我们处于自由射击状态。
examples.english: Per current ROE, we are weapons free.

examples.text: 自由射击状态下，请谨慎识别目标。
examples.english: Under weapons free, identify targets carefully.

terms.definitionEn: Weapons tight is the normal status. Units may only fire on targets identified as hostile in accordance with current ROE.
terms.definition: 单位只能在当前作战规则下识别为敌对目标时才能开火的正常状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 当前武器控制状态为严格控制射击，请确认目标身份。
examples.english: Current weapons control status is weapons tight, confirm target identity.

examples.text: 严格控制射击状态下，未经确认的目标不得攻击。
examples.english: Under weapons tight, do not engage unconfirmed targets.

terms.definitionEn: Weapons hold is the most restrictive status. Units may only fire in self-defense or when ordered by proper higher authority.
terms.definition: 单位只能在自卫或接受上级命令时才能开火的最严格状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 接到命令，武器控制状态变更为禁止射击。
examples.english: Received order, weapons control status changed to weapons hold.

examples.text: 禁止射击状态下，各单位仅可在自卫时开火。
examples.english: Under weapons hold, units may only fire in self-defense.

terms.definitionEn: Directives issued by competent military authority that delineate the circumstances and limitations under which United States forces will initiate and/or continue combat engagement with other forces encountered. Also called ROE.
terms.definition: 作战规则是由军事指挥机构发布的指令，明确美国军队在何种情况下可以开始或继续与其他部队交战。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 根据作战规则，部队在边境巡逻时只能进行自卫反击。
examples.english: According to the rules of engagement, troops can only conduct self-defense counterattacks during border patrols.

examples.text: 部队必须严格遵守作战规则，避免无谓的冲突。
examples.english: Troops must strictly adhere to the rules of engagement to avoid unnecessary conflicts.

terms.definitionEn: The use of force or other attack against the United States, United States forces, or other designated persons or property to preclude or impede the mission and/or duties of United States forces, including the recovery of United States personnel or vital United States Government property.
terms.definition: 敌对行为指的是对美国、美国军队或其他指定人员和财产使用武力或其他攻击手段，以阻止或妨碍美国军队的任务和职责。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 侦察机发现敌方进行了明确的敌对行为，请求立即回应。
examples.english: Reconnaissance aircraft detected clear hostile acts by the enemy, requesting an immediate response.

examples.text: 根据情报，敌人正在进行敌对行为，请保持高度警惕。
examples.english: According to intelligence, the enemy is conducting hostile acts, please remain highly vigilant.

terms.definitionEn: The threat of imminent use of force against the United States, United States forces, or other designated persons or property.
terms.definition: 敌对意图是指对美国、美国军队或其他指定人员和财产即将使用武力的威胁。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 敌军的行动显示出明显的敌对意图，请求授权开火。
examples.english: The enemy's actions show clear hostile intent, requesting permission to open fire.

examples.text: 根据情报分析，敌人有即将发动攻击的敌对意图。
examples.english: According to intelligence analysis, the enemy has hostile intent to launch an imminent attack.

terms.definitionEn: An identification derived from observation and analysis of target characteristics, including visual recognition; electronic support systems; non-cooperative target recognition techniques; identification, friend or foe systems; or other physicsbased identification techniques. Also called PID.
terms.definition: 确认识别是通过观察和分析目标特征，包括视觉识别、电子支持系统、非合作目标识别技术、识别友军或敌军系统或其他基于物理的识别技术。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and liaison, formal register.

examples.text: 在开火前，必须进行确认识别以避免误伤平民。
examples.english: Before opening fire, positive identification must be conducted to avoid civilian casualties.

examples.text: 部队需要通过确认识别来确保目标的准确性。
examples.english: Troops need to conduct positive identification to ensure the accuracy of the target.

terms.definitionEn: The number assigned to an air track so that everyone in the air defense system refers to the same object.
terms.definition: 跟踪编号是指空中目标被分配的号码，以确保空中防御系统中的所有人员都指的是同一个物体。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 新的跟踪编号显示在雷达屏幕上，请各单位注意。
examples.english: A new track number is displayed on the radar screen, please pay attention all units.

examples.text: 跟踪编号已更新，请确认是否与之前的目标一致。
examples.english: The track number has been updated, please confirm if it matches the previous target.

terms.definitionEn: 1. A series of related contacts displayed on a data display console or other display device. 2. To display or record the successive positions of a moving object. 3. To lock onto a point of radiation and obtain guidance therefrom. 4. To keep a gun properly aimed or to point a target-locating instrument continuously at a moving target. 5. The actual path of an aircraft above or a ship on the surface of the Earth. 6. One of the two endless belts on which a full-track or half-track vehicle runs. 7. A metal part forming a path for a moving object such as the track around the inside of a vehicle for moving a mounted machine gun.
terms.definition: 跟踪是指在数据显示控制台或其他显示设备上显示一系列相关接触，或者记录移动物体的连续位置。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 我们成功地跟踪了敌机的移动路线，并记录了其位置。
examples.english: We successfully tracked the enemy aircraft's movement path and recorded its position.

examples.text: 通过雷达跟踪，我们能够实时监控空中目标的动向。
examples.english: Through radar tracking, we can monitor the movement of air targets in real time.

terms.definitionEn: A single, identical display of relevant information shared by more than one command that facilitates collaborative planning and assists all echelons to achieve situational awareness. Also called COP.
terms.definition: 共同作战态势是指多个指挥机构共享的相关信息的单一、相同显示，以便协同规划并帮助各级指挥机构实现态势感知。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and liaison, formal register.

examples.text: 共同作战态势显示敌军正在集结，请各部队做好准备。
examples.english: The common operational picture shows that the enemy is gathering, please prepare all units.

examples.text: 通过共同作战态势，我们能够协调各部队的行动，提高作战效率。
examples.english: Through the common operational picture, we can coordinate the actions of various units and improve combat efficiency.

terms.definitionEn: Measures employed to facilitate the efficient use of airspace to accomplish missions and simultaneously provide safeguards for friendly forces. Also called ACMs.
terms.definition: 空域协调措施是指为了高效利用空域以完成任务，同时为友军提供保障而采取的措施。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and liaison, formal register.

examples.text: 根据空域协调措施，我们需要调整飞行路线以避免冲突。
examples.english: According to airspace coordinating measures, we need to adjust our flight path to avoid conflict.

examples.text: 空域协调措施有助于我们有效地使用空中空间，完成任务。
examples.english: Airspace coordinating measures help us use airspace efficiently to accomplish missions.

terms.definitionEn: Airspace reserved for specific activities in which the operations of one or more airspace users is restricted. Also called ROZ.
terms.definition: 限制性飞行区域是指为特定活动保留的空域，其中一个或多个空域用户的运行受到限制。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and liaison, formal register.

examples.text: 该地区已被划为限制性飞行区域，禁止非授权飞行。
examples.english: The area has been designated as a restricted operations zone, no unauthorized flights are permitted.

examples.text: 限制性飞行区域的设定是为了保护友军部队和重要设施的安全。
examples.english: The establishment of restricted operations zones is to protect the safety of friendly forces and important facilities.

terms.definitionEn: An area where flying drones is prohibited, usually around bases, airports and sensitive sites.
terms.definition: 无人机禁飞区是指禁止飞行无人机的区域，通常在基地、机场和敏感地点周围。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and liaison, formal register.

examples.text: 根据命令，该区域已被划为无人机禁飞区，请勿进入。
examples.english: According to orders, the area has been designated as a no-drone zone, please do not enter.

examples.text: 无人机禁飞区的设定是为了预防无人机对重要设施的威胁。
examples.english: The establishment of no-drone zones is to prevent drones from threatening important facilities.

terms.definitionEn: A temporary ban or limit on flights in a defined area, announced to pilots, for example over an emergency or a VIP visit.
terms.definition: 临时禁飞区是指在特定区域内临时禁止或限制飞行，通常在紧急情况或重要人物访问时通知飞行员。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for safety and security reasons.

examples.text: 根据气象条件，设立临时禁飞区，禁止所有飞行器进入。
examples.english: Due to weather conditions, a temporary flight restriction is in place, prohibiting all aircraft from entering.

examples.text: 飞行员注意，前方有临时禁飞区，请绕行。
examples.english: Pilots, be advised, there is a temporary flight restriction ahead, please divert.

terms.definitionEn: An air defense warning given in the form of a color code corresponding to the degree of air raid probability, with yellow standing for when an attack by hostile aircraft or missiles is probable, red for when an attack by hostile aircraft or missiles is imminent or is in progress, and white for when an attack by hostile aircraft or missiles is improbable. Also called ADWC.
terms.definition: 空中防御警报状态是指通过颜色代码发布的空中防御警报，黄色表示敌机或导弹攻击可能，红色表示即将或正在进行攻击，白色表示攻击可能性低。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for air defense purposes.

examples.text: 根据预警系统，目前空中防御警报状态为黄色。
examples.english: According to the warning system, the current air defense warning condition is yellow.

examples.text: 空中防御警报状态升级为橙色，请各单位保持警惕。
examples.english: The air defense warning condition has been elevated to orange, all units remain vigilant.

collocations: 空中防御警报状态升级
空中防御警报状态降级
空中防御警报状态通知

terms.definitionEn: A command and control facility established by the base commander to serve as the focal point for base security and defense. Also called BDOC.
terms.definition: 基地防御指挥中心是基地指挥官设立的指挥控制设施，负责基地安全和防御的核心工作。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for base defense purposes.

examples.text: 基地防御指挥中心已启动应急预案，各单位请遵照指示行动。
examples.english: The base defense operations center has activated the emergency plan, all units please follow the instructions.

examples.text: 基地防御指挥中心正在协调各部门应对威胁。
examples.english: The base defense operations center is coordinating with all departments to respond to the threat.

collocations: 基地防御指挥中心启动
基地防御指挥中心协调
基地防御指挥中心指示

terms.definitionEn: The local military measures, both normal and emergency, required to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of enemy attacks on, or sabotage of, a base to ensure the maximum capacity of its facilities is available to United States forces.
terms.definition: 基地防御是指通过日常和紧急军事措施，减少或消除敌人对基地的攻击或破坏效果，以确保基地设施的最大能力可供美国军队使用。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for base defense purposes.

examples.text: 基地防御措施已升级，请所有人员配合检查。
examples.english: Base defense measures have been elevated, all personnel please cooperate with the inspections.

examples.text: 为确保基地防御，所有车辆需接受检查。
examples.english: To ensure base defense, all vehicles must be inspected.

terms.definitionEn: Preventive measures taken to mitigate hostile actions against Department of Defense personnel (including family members), resources, facilities, and critical information. Also called FP.
terms.definition: 防卫保护是指采取预防措施，减轻对国防部人员（包括家属）、资源、设施和关键信息的敌对行动。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for force protection purposes.

examples.text: 加强防卫保护，确保人员和设施安全。
examples.english: Enhance force protection to ensure the safety of personnel and facilities.

examples.text: 根据防卫保护条件，调整巡逻路线。
examples.english: Adjust patrol routes according to the force protection condition.

terms.definitionEn: A Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff-approved standard for identification of and recommended responses to terrorist threats against United States personnel and facilities. Also called FPCON.
terms.definition: 防卫保护条件是指联合参谋长委员会批准的标准，用于识别并推荐对美国人员和设施的恐怖主义威胁的应对措施。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for force protection purposes.

examples.text: 根据当前防卫保护条件，实施更严格的出入管理。
examples.english: Implement stricter access control based on the current force protection condition.

examples.text: 防卫保护条件已升级，请各单位提高警惕。
examples.english: The force protection condition has been elevated, all units remain vigilant.

terms.definitionEn: A guarded gate where people and vehicles are checked before they are allowed onto an installation.
terms.definition: 入口控制点是指守卫的大门，人员和车辆在进入设施前需要接受检查。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for access control purposes.

examples.text: 所有车辆和人员必须在入口控制点接受检查。
examples.english: All vehicles and personnel must be inspected at the entry control point.

examples.text: 入口控制点发现可疑物品，已通知相关部门处理。
examples.english: Suspicious items found at the entry control point, notified relevant departments for handling.

terms.definitionEn: An area at or near an entry point, set apart from people and buildings, where vehicles are stopped and searched.
terms.definition: 车辆检查区是指在入口附近设置的区域，远离人员和建筑物，用于停车和搜查车辆。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for vehicle inspection purposes.

examples.text: 请驶入车辆检查区，接受安全检查。
examples.english: Please enter the vehicle search area for a safety inspection.

examples.text: 车辆检查区发现危险品，已疏散人员并通知爆炸物处理小组。
examples.english: Hazardous materials found in the vehicle search area, personnel evacuated and bomb disposal team notified.

terms.definitionEn: The outer boundary of a base or position, usually marked by fences or barriers and watched by guards.
terms.definition: 界限是指基地或阵地的外部边界，通常由围栏或障碍物标记并由警卫看守。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for perimeter security purposes.

examples.text: 巡逻队在界限外发现可疑人员，已截停并进行审查。
examples.english: Patrol team found suspicious individuals outside the perimeter, detained and interrogating.

examples.text: 界限内发现异常情况，请求支援。
examples.english: Abnormal situation found within the perimeter, requesting assistance.

terms.definitionEn: An area of responsibility assigned to a unit; a sector sketch shows its boundaries, positions and fields of fire.
terms.definition: 部门是指分配给单位的责任区域；部门草图显示其边界、位置和火力范围。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for area of responsibility management.

examples.text: 该部门由第二营负责，请各单位注意协调。
examples.english: The sector is under the responsibility of the second battalion, all units please coordinate accordingly.

examples.text: 根据部门划分，调整哨位设置。
examples.english: Adjust sentry positions based on sector division.

terms.definitionEn: A position from which soldiers watch an area and report what they see.
terms.definition: 观察哨是士兵观察特定区域并报告所见情况的位置。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 观察哨报告，敌军正在集结。
examples.english: The observation post reports that the enemy is gathering.

examples.text: 我们需要加强观察哨的警戒。
examples.english: We need to enhance the vigilance of the observation post.

terms.definitionEn: A position placed in front of the defense, usually at night, to give early warning by listening for enemy movement.
terms.definition: 侦听哨通常在夜间设置在防御前方，通过倾听敌方动静以提供早期警报。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 侦听哨发现敌军正在移动。
examples.english: The listening post detected enemy movement.

examples.text: 我们需要在前方设立侦听哨。
examples.english: We need to establish a listening post ahead.

terms.definitionEn: A unit kept ready to move at short notice to respond to an incident or reinforce a threatened area.
terms.definition: 快速反应部队是一个保持待命状态，能够在短时间内行动以应对事件或增援受威胁地区的单位。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 快速反应部队已准备就绪。
examples.english: The quick reaction force is ready.

examples.text: 快速反应部队将立即出发。
examples.english: The quick reaction force will depart immediately.

terms.definitionEn: Duly constituted military, paramilitary, police, and constabulary forces of a state.
terms.definition: 安全部队指一个国家合法组建的军事、准军事、警察和宪兵力量。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 安全部队正在巡逻。
examples.english: The security forces are on patrol.

examples.text: 我们需要加强安全部队的训练。
examples.english: We need to enhance the training of the security forces.

terms.definitionEn: A member of a security force on duty protecting a base, its people and its resources.
terms.definition: 防卫者是执勤保护基地、人员和资源的安保人员。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications.

examples.text: 防卫者正在检查入场证。
examples.english: The defender is checking passes.

examples.text: 防卫者发现可疑人物。
examples.english: The defender spotted a suspicious person.

terms.definitionEn: A detachment sent out to gather information or provide security, on foot (dismounted) or in vehicles (mounted).
terms.definition: patrol是指徒步或乘车巡逻的分队，用于收集信息或提供安全保障。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications.

examples.text: patrol巡逻队正在检查周围地区。
examples.english: The patrol is checking the surrounding area.

examples.text: 我们需要增加patrol巡逻的频率。
examples.english: We need to increase the frequency of patrols.

terms.definitionEn: A security measure applied at irregular times and places so that an attacker cannot predict the defense.
terms.definition: 随机反恐措施是指在不固定的时间和地点采取的安全措施，使攻击者无法预测防御。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 随机反恐措施有效阻止了袭击。
examples.english: Random antiterrorism measures effectively prevented the attack.

examples.text: 我们需要实施更多随机反恐措施。
examples.english: We need to implement more random antiterrorism measures.

terms.definitionEn: The distance kept between a possible bomb, such as a vehicle, and the people or buildings it could harm.
terms.definition: 安全距离是指保持在可能爆炸物体，如车辆，与人员或建筑物之间的距离，以减少伤害。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and instructions.

examples.text: 保持安全距离以减少爆炸伤害。
examples.english: Maintain standoff distance to reduce blast injury.

examples.text: 安全距离是确保安全的关键。
examples.english: Standoff distance is key to ensuring safety.

terms.definitionEn: Any obstruction or coordinated series of obstacles designed or employed to channel, direct, restrict, delay, or stop movement.
terms.definition: 障碍物是指任何阻碍或一系列协调的障碍，旨在引导、限制、延迟或阻止运动。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 障碍物阻止了敌军的前进。
examples.english: The barrier stopped the enemy's advance.

examples.text: 我们需要在关键路径设立障碍物。
examples.english: We need to set up barriers on key routes.

terms.definitionEn: Measures, such as barriers, film on windows and distance, that reduce the harm an explosion can do.
terms.definition: 减爆措施是指通过障碍物、窗户上的薄膜和保持距离等手段，减少爆炸造成的伤害。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 减爆措施降低了爆炸的危害。
examples.english: Blast mitigation reduced the harm of the explosion.

examples.text: 我们需要实施更多减爆措施。
examples.english: We need to implement more blast mitigation measures.

terms.definitionEn: A posted state that tells everyone on a base whether an attack is unlikely, expected or under way, and what protective action to take.
terms.definition: 警报状态是一个通知基地所有人是否有攻击威胁及需要采取的保护措施的状态通告。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio and briefings to announce changes in alarm status.

examples.text: 警报状态已升级为黄色，所有人员进入防空位置。
examples.english: Alarm condition has upgraded to yellow, all personnel move to anti-air positions.

examples.text: 警报状态解除，可恢复正常活动。
examples.english: Alarm condition cleared, resume normal activity.

terms.definitionEn: The check of a base after an attack to find damage, casualties and unexploded ordnance.
terms.definition: 事后侦察是指在攻击后检查基地，以确定损坏、伤亡和未爆弹药的情况。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications after an attack.

examples.text: 事后侦察小组正在检查设施损坏情况。
examples.english: Post-attack reconnaissance team is checking facility damage.

examples.text: 事后侦察发现有未爆弹药，请通知排爆小组。
examples.english: Post-attack reconnaissance found unexploded ordnance, notify EOD team.

terms.definitionEn: Explosive ordnance that has been primed, fused, armed, or otherwise prepared for action and has been fired, dropped, launched, projected, or placed in such a manner as to constitute a hazard to operations, installations, personnel, or material and remains unexploded either by malfunction or design or for any other cause. Also called UXO.
terms.definition: 未爆弹药指已经准备好爆炸但未爆炸的弹药，对人员、设备和行动构成威胁。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports to indicate UXO presence.

examples.text: 发现未爆弹药，请保持安全距离并通知专业人员。
examples.english: Unexploded ordnance found, keep safe distance and notify professionals.

examples.text: 排爆小组正在处理未爆弹药。
examples.english: EOD team is handling unexploded ordnance.

terms.definitionEn: To stay indoors or in the nearest protected place until told it is safe to move.
terms.definition: 就地避险是指在收到警报后，立即进入室内或最近的安全地点，直到被告知安全后才能移动。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and briefings during a threat.

examples.text: 收到就地避险命令，请立即进入最近的防护所。
examples.english: Received shelter in place order, enter nearest shelter immediately.

examples.text: 就地避险直到收到解除警报通知。
examples.english: Shelter in place until all clear is announced.

terms.definitionEn: A reinforced shelter, often of concrete or sandbags, that protects people from blast and fragments.
terms.definition: 地堡是一种用于保护人员免受爆炸和碎片伤害的加固避难所，通常由混凝土或沙袋建成。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports to describe protective structures.

examples.text: 所有人员进入地堡，等待进一步通知。
examples.english: All personnel enter bunker, await further notice.

examples.text: 地堡能够抵御常规武器的冲击波。
examples.english: Bunker can withstand conventional weapon blast waves.

terms.definitionEn: Cover protects from fire; concealment only hides from view.
terms.definition: 掩蔽与伪装中，掩蔽是指保护自己免受火力攻击，而伪装是指隐藏自己以免被发现。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings to describe protective measures.

examples.text: 掩蔽与伪装小组正在检查设施外观。
examples.english: Cover and concealment team is checking facility appearance.

examples.text: 优化掩蔽与伪装以减少目标显著性。
examples.english: Optimize cover and concealment to reduce target signature.

terms.definitionEn: Knowing where every person is and whether they are safe, especially after an attack or alarm.
terms.definition: 人员清点是指在攻击或警报后，确定每个人的位置和安全情况。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications to confirm personnel safety.

examples.text: 人员清点显示所有人员均已安全到位。
examples.english: Accountability shows all personnel safe in place.

examples.text: 事后侦察后进行人员清点以确认安全。
examples.english: Conduct accountability after post-attack reconnaissance to confirm safety.

terms.definitionEn: An order that stops all movement on an installation or in a building until the threat has passed.
terms.definition: 封锁是指在威胁尚未解除之前，禁止在设施或建筑物内的任何移动的命令。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and briefings to control movement.

examples.text: 封锁命令已下达，请停止所有移动。
examples.english: Lockdown order given, cease all movement.

examples.text: 封锁期间禁止任何人员进入或离开设施。
examples.english: During lockdown, no personnel allowed in or out of facility.

terms.definitionEn: The announcement that a threat has ended and normal activity may resume.
terms.definition: 解除警报是指宣布威胁已经结束，可以恢复正常活动的通知。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and briefings to end threat status.

examples.text: 解除警报，威胁已结束，可恢复正常活动。
examples.english: All clear, threat ended, resume normal activity.

examples.text: 解除警报后进行设施检查以确保安全。
examples.english: After all clear, inspect facilities to ensure safety.

terms.definitionEn: The person in charge of all response activity at the scene of an incident.
terms.definition: 现场指挥官是指在事件现场负责所有应急响应活动的人员。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications to describe incident response leadership.

examples.text: 现场指挥官正在协调救援行动。
examples.english: Incident commander coordinating rescue operations.

examples.text: 现场指挥官下达封锁命令以控制局势。
examples.english: Incident commander issued lockdown order to control situation.

terms.definitionEn: A headquarters for the coordination of information and resources to support incident management activities. Also called EOC.
terms.definition: 应急指挥中心是协调信息和资源以支持应急管理活动的总部。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.text: 应急指挥中心接收到台风预警，立即启动应急预案。
examples.english: The EOC received a typhoon warning and immediately activated the emergency plan.

examples.text: 应急指挥中心协调各部门资源，有效应对地震灾害。
examples.english: The EOC coordinated resources from various departments to effectively respond to the earthquake disaster.

terms.definitionEn: A system that warns everyone on an installation at once, through sirens, loudspeakers, phones and computers.
terms.definition: 大众通知系统是通过警报器、扬声器、电话和电脑等方式同时向驻地内所有人发出警告的系统。
terms.registerNote: Used for radio announcements and written reports.

examples.text: 大众通知系统发出防空警报，全体人员立即撤离。
examples.english: The mass notification system issued an air raid alert, and all personnel immediately evacuated.

examples.text: 大众通知系统通过广播发布化学泄漏预警。
examples.english: The mass notification system issued a chemical spill warning via broadcast.

terms.definitionEn: Fire, such as mortar, rocket or artillery rounds, aimed at a target the firer cannot see, usually along a high curved path.
terms.definition: 间接火力是指通过迫击炮、火箭或炮弹等武器，对射手看不到的目标进行射击，通常沿着高弧线路径。
terms.registerNote: Common in tactical radio communications and written orders.

examples.text: 炮兵部队进行间接火力打击，摧毁敌方指挥部。
examples.english: Artillery units conducted indirect fire strikes, destroying the enemy command center.

examples.text: 间接火力覆盖敌方阵地，掩护步兵推进。
examples.english: Indirect fire covered the enemy positions, covering the advance of the infantry.

terms.definitionEn: C-RAM is a tactical mission that provides detection, warning, C2, and intercept of RAM in flight and engagement of enemy sources of IDF.
terms.term: 反火箭弹、炮兵和迫击炮系统

equivalents.text: 反火箭弹、炮兵和迫击炮系统

terms.definition: 反火箭弹、炮兵和迫击炮系统是一种战术任务，用于检测、警告、指挥控制和拦截火箭、炮兵和迫击炮弹，并攻击敌方间接火力来源。
terms.registerNote: Technical term, used in military reports and briefings.

examples.text: 反火箭弹、炮兵和迫击炮系统拦截敌方火箭弹。
examples.english: The C-RAM system intercepted the enemy's rocket.

examples.text: 反火箭弹、炮兵和迫击炮系统发现并摧毁敌方迫击炮阵地。
examples.english: The C-RAM system detected and destroyed the enemy mortar positions.

collocations: 反火箭弹、炮兵和迫击炮系统拦截
反火箭弹、炮兵和迫击炮系统发现
反火箭弹、炮兵和迫击炮系统摧毁

terms.definitionEn: The risk that a person with authorized access, such as an employee or contractor, uses that access to cause harm.
terms.definition: 内部威胁是指拥有授权访问权限的人员，如员工或承包商，利用其权限造成伤害的风险。
terms.registerNote: Used in security briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 内部威胁调查小组调查数据泄露事件。
examples.english: The insider threat investigation team investigated the data leak incident.

examples.text: 内部威胁培训提高了官兵的安全意识。
examples.english: Insider threat training raised the security awareness of the troops.

terms.definitionEn: A nation that allows forces to operate in or to transit through its territory. Also called HN.
terms.definition: 主权国是指允许军队在其领土内行动或通过的国家。
terms.registerNote: Formal term, used in diplomatic and military communications.

examples.text: 主权国政府批准我们的军事演习计划。
examples.english: The host nation government approved our military exercise plan.

examples.text: 主权国提供后勤支持，确保演习顺利进行。
examples.english: The host nation provided logistical support to ensure the smooth conduct of the exercise.

terms.definitionEn: Personnel organized and/or employed for security, whether they are civil or military, federal, state or provincial, or local. Also called FSF.
terms.definition: 外国安全部队是指为安全目的组织或雇佣的任何人员，无论是民事或军事，联邦、州或省，或地方。
terms.registerNote: Used in liaison communications and written reports.

examples.text: 外国安全部队与我们联合巡逻边境地区。
examples.english: The foreign security forces conducted joint patrols with us in the border area.

examples.text: 外国安全部队提供情报支持，帮助我们识别潜在威胁。
examples.english: The foreign security forces provided intelligence support to help us identify potential threats.

terms.definitionEn: A bilateral or multilateral agreement that defines the legal position of a visiting military force deployed in the territory of a friendly state. Also called SOFA.
terms.definition: 驻军地位协定是定义友好国家领土内驻扎军队的法律地位的双边或多边协议。
terms.registerNote: Formal term, used in diplomatic and military communications.

examples.text: 驻军地位协定明确了驻军的法律地位和权利。
examples.english: The status-of-forces agreement clearly defined the legal status and rights of the troops stationed.

examples.text: 驻军地位协定的签署标志着两国军事合作的深化。
examples.english: The signing of the status-of-forces agreement marked a deepening of military cooperation between the two countries.

terms.definitionEn: The legal authority to investigate, arrest and try people for offenses in a given place.
terms.definition: 司法管辖权是指在特定地区调查、逮捕和审判犯罪行为的法律权力。
terms.registerNote: Legal term, used in formal documents and communications.

examples.text: 司法管辖权协议解决了跨国犯罪案件的管辖问题。
examples.english: The jurisdiction agreement resolved the issue of jurisdiction over transnational crime cases.

examples.text: 司法管辖权的划分确保了案件的顺利审理。
examples.english: The delineation of jurisdiction ensured the smooth trial of the case.

terms.definitionEn: A citizen of the host country, for example one working on or near a base.
terms.definition: 当地国民是指驻地附近工作的东道国公民。
terms.registerNote: Used in base operations and written reports.

examples.text: 当地国民在基地工作，了解当地文化和法律。
examples.english: Local nationals working on the base understand local culture and laws.

examples.text: 当地国民提供翻译服务，促进了双方的理解。
examples.english: Local nationals provided translation services, promoting mutual understanding.

terms.definitionEn: A person assigned to accompany a visitor or contractor who may not move on the base alone.
terms.definition: 负责陪同访客或承包商的人员，确保他们在基地内不单独行动。
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and radio communications for visitor management.

examples.text: 护送人员将随时待命，确保访客安全抵达会议室。
examples.english: The escort personnel will be on standby at all times to ensure the visitor arrives at the meeting room safely.

examples.text: 护送人员需持有有效证件，并全程陪同访客在基地内活动。
examples.english: The escort personnel must have valid credentials and accompany the visitor throughout their activities on the base.

terms.definitionEn: The list of people authorized to enter a facility or area, checked against their badges.
terms.definition: 允许进入设施或区域的人员名单，用于核对他们的证件。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for access control.

examples.text: 请确认你的姓名是否在进入名单中。
examples.english: Please confirm if your name is on the access roster.

examples.text: 未经授权的人员不得进入，除非其名字在进入名单中。
examples.english: Unauthorized personnel are not allowed to enter unless their name is on the access roster.

terms.definitionEn: Passing the current situation, open issues and equipment from one duty shift to the next.
terms.definition: 将当前情况、未解决问题和设备信息从一个值班班次传递给下一个班次。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for shift changes.

examples.text: 班次交接将于1800小时进行，请各班做好准备。
examples.english: Shift handover will take place at 1800 hours. Please be prepared.

examples.text: 上一班次需将当前情况和设备状态详细告知下一班次。
examples.english: The previous shift must inform the next shift of the current situation and equipment status in detail.

terms.definitionEn: The chronological log in which a security or police desk records incidents and actions.
terms.definition: 安全或警卫值班台记录事件和行动的按时间顺序排列的记录。
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and radio communications for security logging.

examples.text: 所有事件必须记录在日志中，以便后续审查。
examples.english: All incidents must be recorded in the blotter for future review.

examples.text: 安全值班人员需定期检查日志，确保记录的准确性。
examples.english: Security duty personnel must regularly check the blotter to ensure the accuracy of the records.

terms.definitionEn: The written record of everyone who has held a piece of evidence, from collection onward, so it can be trusted.
terms.definition: 记录从采集开始每个持有证据的人员的书面记录，以确保证据的可信度。
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and formal communications for evidence handling.

examples.text: 证据保管链必须完整，以确保证据的合法性。
examples.english: The chain of custody must be complete to ensure the admissibility of evidence.

examples.text: 每次证据交接都需要有签名，以保证证据保管链的连续性。
examples.english: Each evidence handover requires a signature to ensure the continuity of the chain of custody.

terms.definitionEn: The exercise of delegated authority over designated airspace and users through control procedures and coordination measures to maximize operational effectiveness.
terms.definition: 空域管制是通过控制程序和协调措施对指定空域和用户行使授权权力，以最大化作战效能。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for airspace management.

examples.text: 空域管制部门正在协调飞行任务，确保空域安全。
examples.english: The airspace control department is coordinating flight tasks to ensure airspace safety.

examples.text: 空域管制命令已下达，所有飞行单位必须遵守。
examples.english: The airspace control order has been issued, and all flying units must comply.

terms.definitionEn: A method used to task and disseminate to components, subordinate units, and command and control agencies projected sorties, capabilities, or forces for targeting and specific missions. Also called ATO.
terms.definition: 空中任务令是一种用于分配和传达给下属单位、部队和指挥控制机构的预定飞行任务、能力或力量的方法，以便进行目标定位和特定任务。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for mission coordination.

examples.text: 空中任务令已发布，请各单位确认接收。
examples.english: The air tasking order has been issued. Please confirm receipt.

examples.text: 空中任务令中列出了所有计划飞行的任务和目标。
examples.english: The air tasking order lists all planned flight tasks and targets.

terms.definitionEn: Weapons and equipment for actively combating air targets from the ground. Also called ADA.
terms.definition: 高射炮兵是用于从地面主动对抗空中目标的武器和设备。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for air defense operations.

examples.text: 高射炮兵部队已进入阵地，准备拦截来袭目标。
examples.english: The air defense artillery troops have entered their positions and are ready to intercept incoming targets.

examples.text: 高射炮兵需要与雷达部门紧密协作，以提高拦截效率。
examples.english: Air defense artillery needs to closely coordinate with radar units to improve interception efficiency.

terms.definitionEn: A device that emits a signal positively identifying it as a friendly. Also called IFF.
terms.definition: 识别友军系统是一种发射信号以确定其为友军的装置。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports for airspace identification.

examples.text: 识别友军系统已激活，请确认友军身份。
examples.english: The identification, friend or foe system has been activated. Please confirm friendly status.

examples.text: 识别友军系统故障可能导致误判，需及时维修。
examples.english: Identification, friend or foe system malfunctions can lead to misidentifications and must be repaired promptly.

terms.definitionEn: The code an aircraft's transponder sends; 'squawk' is also the order to set that code.
terms.definition: 编码是飞机应答机发送的代码，也称为“squawk”。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications for air traffic control.

examples.text: 飞行员需设置正确的编码，以便控制塔台识别。
examples.english: Pilots must set the correct squawk code for identification by the control tower.

examples.text: 控制塔台命令：所有飞机请设置7700编码。
examples.english: Control tower command: All aircraft, please squawk 7700.

terms.definitionEn: A band of altitudes, between a lower and an upper limit, assigned to one aircraft or activity.
terms.definition: 高度区是指在上下限之间分配给一架飞机或活动的高度带。
terms.registerNote: Used in air traffic control, briefings, and reports.

examples.text: 根据命令，我们飞机将在高度区15000-20000米内执行任务。
examples.english: According to orders, our aircraft will perform the mission within the altitude block of 15000-20000 meters.

examples.text: 目标飞行员需注意高度区限制，避免与其他飞行器冲突。
examples.english: Target pilots need to pay attention to the altitude block restrictions to avoid conflicts with other aircraft.

terms.definitionEn: Coordinating times, places and altitudes so that friendly aircraft, drones and fires do not interfere with or endanger each other.
terms.definition: 冲突避免是通过协调时间、地点和高度，确保友军飞机、无人机和火力不会相互干扰或危害。
terms.registerNote: Used in mission planning, briefings, and liaison.

examples.text: 为确保任务顺利执行，各单位需进行冲突避免，协调好时间和空域。
examples.english: To ensure the smooth execution of the mission, all units need to deconflict and coordinate time and airspace.

examples.text: 通过冲突避免，我们成功避免了友军之间的干扰。
examples.english: Through deconfliction, we successfully avoided interference between friendly forces.

terms.definitionEn: A three-dimensional permissive fire support coordination measure with an associated airspace coordinating measure used to facilitate the integration of fires.
terms.definition: 打击箱是一个三维的允许火力支援协调措施，用于促进火力的整合。
terms.registerNote: Used in air strike planning, briefings, and reports.

examples.text: 根据作战计划，我们将在指定打击箱内进行火力打击。
examples.english: According to the operational plan, we will conduct fire strikes within the designated kill box.

examples.text: 所有飞机需注意打击箱的边界限制，避免误入其他区域。
examples.english: All aircraft need to pay attention to the boundary restrictions of the kill box to avoid straying into other areas.

terms.definitionEn: Any combination of characters or pronounceable words, which identifies a communication facility, a command, an authority, an activity, or a unit; used primarily for establishing and maintaining communications. Also called CS.
terms.definition: 呼号是用于建立和维持通信的字符或可发音词组的组合，用于识别通信设施、指挥部、权力机构、活动或单位。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication, briefings, and reports.

examples.text: 所有飞行员需使用指定呼号进行通话，确保通信顺畅。
examples.english: All pilots must use the designated call sign for communication to ensure smooth communication.

examples.text: 由于呼号冲突，我们需要重新分配呼号以避免混淆。
examples.english: Due to call sign conflict, we need to reallocate call signs to avoid confusion.

terms.definitionEn: A code word, which provides no security, that serves the sole purpose of shortening of messages rather than the concealment of their content.
terms.definition: 简语代码是一种用于缩短消息的代码词，不提供安全性，仅用于简化消息内容。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and briefings.

examples.text: 使用简语代码可以缩短通信时间，提高通信效率。
examples.english: Using brevity codes can shorten communication time and improve communication efficiency.

examples.text: 所有单位需熟悉并使用简语代码，以便快速响应。
examples.english: All units need to be familiar with and use brevity codes to respond quickly.

terms.definitionEn: The radio call in which a unit or aircraft reports to a controller that it has arrived and is ready, with its status.
terms.definition: 部队或飞机向指挥员报告到达并准备就绪的无线电通话，包括其状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and liaison.

examples.text: 抵达指定位置后，飞机需立即进行报到，汇报状态。
examples.english: Upon arrival at the designated position, the aircraft must immediately check-in and report its status.

examples.text: 由于天气原因，我们将延迟报到，请各单位注意。
examples.english: Due to weather conditions, we will delay our check-in, please be aware all units.

terms.definitionEn: A report giving the situation in the area of a reporting unit or formation. Also called SITREP.
terms.definition: 单位或部队在其所在区域情况的报告。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports, briefings, and liaison.

examples.text: 各单位需定期提交情况报告，确保指挥部了解最新动态。
examples.english: All units need to submit situation reports regularly to keep the command aware of the latest developments.

examples.text: 根据情况报告，我们调整了作战计划以应对新威胁。
examples.english: Based on the situation report, we adjusted the operational plan to address new threats.

terms.definitionEn: A concise narrative report of essential information covering events or conditions that may have an immediate and significant effect on current planning and operations that is afforded the most expeditious means of transmission consistent with requisite security. Also called SPOTREP. (Note: In reconnaissance and surveillance usage, spot report is not to be used.)
terms.definition: 对当前计划和行动有立即和重大影响的事件或条件的简明叙述报告，以最快的安全方式传输。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports, briefings, and liaison.

examples.text: 发现敌军活动，立即提交战场报告，以便快速响应。
examples.english: Upon discovering enemy activity, submit a spot report immediately to enable rapid response.

examples.text: 战场报告显示，敌军正在集结，请各单位做好准备。
examples.english: The spot report indicates that the enemy is gathering, please be prepared all units.

terms.definitionEn: The standard nine-line radio message used to request evacuation of casualties, giving location, frequency, number of patients and other essentials.
terms.definition: 用于请求伤员疏散的标准九线无线电信息，包括位置、频率、患者人数等关键信息。
terms.registerNote: Used in medical evacuation requests and liaison.

examples.text: 伤员情况紧急，请立即发送九线医疗后送请求。
examples.english: The casualty situation is urgent, please send the nine-line medical evacuation request immediately.

examples.text: 根据九线医疗后送请求，我们将派遣医疗直升机前往救援。
examples.english: Based on the nine-line medical evacuation request, we will dispatch a medical helicopter for rescue.

terms.definitionEn: A map position given as letters and numbers of a grid system such as MGRS.
terms.definition: 地图上的位置，用网格系统中的字母和数字表示。
terms.registerNote: Used in target designation, briefings, and reports.

examples.text: 目标位置的网格坐标是12345678，请确认收悉。
examples.english: The grid reference of the target position is 12345678, please confirm receipt.

examples.text: 根据网格坐标，我们成功定位了目标，并进行了打击。
examples.english: Based on the grid reference, we successfully located the target and conducted a strike.

terms.definitionEn: The direction to an object measured clockwise from north, in degrees.
terms.definition: 从正北方向顺时针测量的物体方向，以度数表示。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio and briefings to indicate direction.

examples.text: 方位角为三五零度，目标位于东北方向。
examples.english: The bearing is 350 degrees, target is to the northeast.

examples.text: 根据最新情报，敌机的方位角已变为一八零度。
examples.english: According to the latest intelligence, the enemy aircraft's bearing has changed to 180 degrees.

terms.definitionEn: The actual time at which munitions impact the target. Also called TOT.
terms.definition: 弹药命中目标的实际时间。
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and radio communications for coordination.

examples.text: 目标到达时间预计为十五分钟后。
examples.english: Time on target is estimated in 15 minutes.

examples.text: 所有飞机需在目标到达时间前到达指定位置。
examples.english: All aircraft must be in position before time on target.

terms.definitionEn: A CONTACT whose identity is unknown.
terms.definition: 身份未知的接触目标。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to indicate an unidentified contact.

examples.text: 发现一架BOGEY，距离我方十公里，正在接近。
examples.english: A BOGEY detected, 10 kilometers from us, approaching.

examples.text: 此BOGEY未响应我方识别信号，请求进一步指示。
examples.english: This BOGEY is not responding to our IFF signal, request further instructions.

terms.definitionEn: 1. [A/A] [AIR-MAR] Positively identified as an enemy in accordance with (IAW) theater ID criteria. The term does not imply direction or authority to engage. 2. * [SO] A SUSPECT whose orbital parameters are such that it may become a collection and/or counterspace concern to a spacecraft in the relative near-term, therefore limiting decision space.
terms.definition: 根据战区识别标准确定为敌人的目标，但不意味着授权攻击。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to indicate a positively identified enemy.

examples.text: 确认BANDIT，请求允许拦截。
examples.english: Confirmed BANDIT, request permission to intercept.

examples.text: 该BANDIT正在快速接近我方领空，建议采取防卫措施。
examples.english: This BANDIT is rapidly approaching our airspace, suggest taking defensive measures.

terms.definitionEn: A contact identified as enemy upon which clearance to fire is authorized IAW theater rules of engagement (ROE). WARNING This use of HOSTILE is as a brevity term for air engagements and should not be confused with the same term in tactical data link identification.
terms.definition: 按照战区作战规则授权开火的敌方接触目标。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to indicate an enemy upon which firing is authorized.

examples.text: 目标已被识别为HOSTILE，请求开火许可。
examples.english: Target identified as HOSTILE, request clearance to fire.

examples.text: 根据战区规则，此HOSTILE已被授权开火。
examples.english: According to theater ROE, this HOSTILE is authorized to engage.

terms.definitionEn: A positively identified FRIENDLY aircraft, ship, spacecraft, or ground position.
terms.definition: 确认为友方的飞机、船只、航天器或地面位置。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to indicate a friendly force.

examples.text: 确认FRIENDLY，请继续执行任务。
examples.english: Confirmed FRIENDLY, continue with the mission.

examples.text: 该FRIENDLY飞机请求与我方编队。
examples.english: This FRIENDLY aircraft requests to join our formation.

terms.definitionEn: 1. A code meaning “information not available.” 2. An aircraft or ship that has not been determined to be hostile, friendly, or neutral. 3. An identity applied to an evaluated track that has not been identified.
terms.definition: 1. 表示信息不可用的代码。2. 未确定为敌对、友好或中立的飞机或船只。3. 应用于未识别的评估轨迹的身份。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to indicate an unidentified contact.

examples.text: 此目标身份UNKNOWN，请保持警惕。
examples.english: This target's identity is UNKNOWN, remain vigilant.

examples.text: 根据雷达显示，有UNKNOWN飞行器接近我方。
examples.english: According to radar, there is an UNKNOWN aircraft approaching us.

terms.definitionEn: 1. [A/A] [A/S] [S/A] Hit observed with valid DWE against a target. 2. * [S/A] [S/S] Informative call to observer or spotter 5 seconds prior to estimated time of impact.
terms.definition: 1. 观察到有效的目标指示器击中目标。2. 向观察员或观察手发出5秒前估计的撞击时间的提示。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to indicate a hit on target.

examples.text: 观察到SPLASH，目标已被摧毁。
examples.english: SPLASH observed, target destroyed.

examples.text: 五秒后SPLASH，所有飞机请做好准备。
examples.english: SPLASH in 5 seconds, all aircraft stand by.

terms.definitionEn: Radar warning receiver indication of an air interceptor threat in track or launch.
terms.definition: 雷达预警接收器显示空中拦截威胁正在跟踪或发射。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to indicate an air interceptor threat.

examples.text: 雷达警告接收机显示SPIKE信号，请采取规避措施。
examples.english: Radar warning receiver indicates SPIKE, take evasive actions.

examples.text: 检测到SPIKE，敌方可能已锁定我方。
examples.english: SPIKE detected, enemy may have locked on to us.

terms.definitionEn: 1.* [A/A] [A/S] [S/A] [SO] Aircrew does not have visual contact with the TARGET or BANDIT. Opposite of TALLY. 2.* Indicates that radio communications could not be established with the distant end on a specified radio net.
terms.definition: 1. 飞行员没有看到目标或敌机。2. 表示在指定的无线电网络上无法建立与远端的通信。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to indicate lack of visual contact or communication.

examples.text: 目标未见，报告NO JOY。
examples.english: Target not in sight, report NO JOY.

examples.text: 无法建立通信，报告NO JOY。
examples.english: Unable to establish communications, report NO JOY.

terms.definitionEn: Sighting of a target, non-friendly aircraft, or enemy position. Opposite of NO JOY.
terms.definition: 发现目标、非友方飞机或敌方位置。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to confirm sighting.

examples.text: 目标确认，TALLY，继续跟踪。
examples.english: Target acquired, TALLY, continue tracking.

examples.text: 敌机TALLY，请求攻击许可。
examples.english: Enemy aircraft TALLY, request permission to engage.

terms.definitionEn: Prebriefed fuel state needed for recovery.
terms.definition: 预先简报的回收所需的燃料状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to indicate fuel state for recovery.

examples.text: 燃油BINGO，请求返航。
examples.english: BINGO fuel, request return.

examples.text: 根据预先简报，BINGO状态为1500磅。
examples.english: According to prebrief, BINGO state is 1500 pounds.

terms.definitionEn: Stop firing, do not open fire. Missiles in flight will continue to intercept; continue to track.
terms.definition: 停止射击，但已发射的导弹继续拦截，继续跟踪。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to stop firing.

examples.text: 所有单位，CEASE FIRE，停止射击。
examples.english: All units, CEASE FIRE, stop firing.

examples.text: 收到CEASE FIRE，继续跟踪导弹轨迹。
examples.english: Received CEASE FIRE, continue tracking missile trajectory.

terms.definitionEn: Weapons control status. Fire only: 1. * FREE: at targets not identified as FRIENDLY IAW current ROE. 2. * TIGHT: at targets positively identified as HOSTILE IAW current ROE. 3. * HOLD/SAFE: in self-defense or in response to a formal order. NOTE NATO uses WEAPONS to determine munitions available or remaining, similar to WHAT STATE.
terms.definition: 武器控制状态：根据当前的作战规则，可以对未确定为友方的目标开火。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to indicate weapons control status.

examples.text: 改变武器状态为WEAPONS FREE，按当前作战规则开火。
examples.english: Change weapons status to FREE, fire according to current ROE.

examples.text: 武器控制状态WEAPONS TIGHT，确认敌机后开火。
examples.english: Weapons control status TIGHT, fire after confirming enemy aircraft.

terms.definitionEn: Radio procedure word: wait, I will answer shortly.
terms.definition: 无线电操作术语：请等待，我会尽快回答。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to indicate waiting.

examples.text: 收到，STAND BY，稍后回答。
examples.english: Received, STAND BY, will answer shortly.

examples.text: 请STAND BY，等待进一步指示。
examples.english: Please STAND BY, await further instructions.

terms.definitionEn: Radio procedure word: repeat your last message, or the part named.
terms.definition: 在无线电通信中，要求对方重复上一次的信息或指定的部分内容。
terms.registerNote: Common in radio communications, used to request repetition of a message.

examples.text: 请SAY AGAIN最后一条消息，通信不清晰。
examples.english: Please SAY AGAIN the last message, communication is unclear.

examples.text: SAY AGAIN您关于敌方位置的报告，确认无误。
examples.english: SAY AGAIN your report on enemy location to confirm accuracy.

terms.definitionEn: Radio transmission received; does not indicate compliance or reaction.
terms.definition: 在无线电通信中表示收到信息，但不表示是否服从或回应。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to acknowledge receipt.

examples.text: 收到，ROGER。
examples.english: Received, ROGER.

examples.text: 你的通话ROGER，但无法执行。
examples.english: Your transmission ROGER, but cannot comply.

terms.definitionEn: Will comply with received instructions.
terms.definition: 在无线电通信中表示将遵照接收到的指示行事。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to indicate compliance.

examples.text: WILCO，将按指示行动。
examples.english: WILCO, will act according to instructions.

examples.text: 收到指令，WILCO，立即执行。
examples.english: Received instructions, WILCO, execute immediately.

terms.definitionEn: Radio procedure words that interrupt traffic on a busy net to pass an urgent message.
terms.definition: 在无线电通信中，用于打断繁忙的通信网络以传递紧急信息。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to interrupt traffic for urgent message.

examples.text: BREAK BREAK，紧急传输。
examples.english: BREAK BREAK, urgent transmission.

examples.text: 所有单位，BREAK BREAK，听好。
examples.english: All units, BREAK BREAK, listen up.

terms.definitionEn: The right to give orders and make decisions within a defined area of responsibility.
terms.definition: 在指定的责任范围内，有权发布命令并做出决定。
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and briefings to indicate right to give orders.

examples.text: 该行动需上级权限批准。
examples.english: The action requires higher authority approval.

examples.text: 在授权范围内做出决定。
examples.english: Make decisions within the authority.

terms.definitionEn: The action by which a commander assigns part of his or her authority, commensurate with the assigned task, to a subordinate commander.
terms.definition: 指挥官将其部分权力，根据所分配的任务，授予下属指挥官的行动。
terms.registerNote: Used formally in written orders or briefings.

examples.text: 授权委托已下达，请确认接收。
examples.english: Delegation of authority issued, please confirm receipt.

examples.text: 根据授权委托，第3大队负责此次任务。
examples.english: According to the delegation of authority, Squadron 3 is responsible for this mission.

terms.definitionEn: A commander or individual who has the authority to require consultation between the specific functions or activities involving forces of two or more Services, joint force components, or forces of the same Service or agencies but does not have the authority to compel agreement.
terms.definition: 一个指挥官或个人有权要求两个或多个军种、联合部队组成部分或同一军种的部队或机构之间的特定功能或活动进行协商，但无权强制达成协议。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written instructions or radio communications.

examples.text: 协调权归指挥部所有，请遵守相关规定。
examples.english: Coordinating authority belongs to the command headquarters, please follow the relevant regulations.

examples.text: 根据协调权，我们需要联合各部门规划行动。
examples.english: According to coordinating authority, we need to jointly plan actions with various departments.

terms.definitionEn: Formal agreement by the person with authority that an action may go ahead.
terms.definition: 有权力的人正式同意某项行动可以继续进行。
terms.registerNote: Used formally in written orders or radio communications.

examples.text: 等待上级批准后再行动。
examples.english: Wait for higher approval before taking action.

examples.text: 行动计划已获得批准，立即执行。
examples.english: Action plan has been approved, execute immediately.

terms.definitionEn: Contact kept between units or organizations so that they understand each other and act together.
terms.definition: 单位或组织之间保持的联系，以便相互理解并协同行动。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports or radio communications.

examples.text: 需加强与友军的联络，确保信息畅通。
examples.english: Need to strengthen liaison with allied forces to ensure information flow.

examples.text: 联络官正在与其他部门协调任务细节。
examples.english: Liaison officer is coordinating task details with other departments.

terms.definitionEn: The ability to act together coherently, effectively, and efficiently to achieve tactical, operational, and strategic objectives.
terms.definition: 能够协同一致、有效和高效地行动，以实现战术、作战和战略目标。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports or briefings.

examples.text: 互操作性是多国部队成功合作的关键。
examples.english: Interoperability is key to successful multinational cooperation.

examples.text: 通过训练提高我们的互操作性。
examples.english: Improve our interoperability through training.

terms.definitionEn: Giving partners the information they need, within the limits of its classification and release rules.
terms.definition: 信息共享是指在分类和发布规则允许的范围内，向合作伙伴提供其所需的信息。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports or radio communications.

examples.text: 信息共享有助于提高整体作战效率。
examples.english: Information sharing helps improve overall combat efficiency.

examples.text: 根据信息共享协议，传输数据给盟军。
examples.english: According to the information sharing agreement, transmit data to the allies.

terms.definitionEn: A restriction a nation places on how its forces may be used, or on who may see a piece of information.
terms.definition: 保留条件是指一个国家对其部队的使用方式或信息的接收者设定的限制。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written orders or briefings.

examples.text: 此次行动有保留条件，请注意相关限制。
examples.english: This operation has caveats, please note the relevant restrictions.

examples.text: 保留条件可能影响任务执行，需谨慎处理。
examples.english: Caveats may affect mission execution, handle with care.

terms.definitionEn: The determination that official information requires, in the interests of national security, a specific degree of protection against unauthorized disclosure, coupled with a designation signifying that such a determination has been made.
terms.definition: 密级是指为了国家安全利益，对官方信息需要特定保护程度的决定，并附有表示已作出该决定的标志。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports or instructions.

examples.text: 该文件的密级为机密，请妥善保管。
examples.english: The classification of this document is secret, please keep it safe.

examples.text: 根据密级规定，此信息仅限内部使用。
examples.english: According to classification regulations, this information is for internal use only.

terms.definitionEn: Formal permission to give classified or controlled information to a partner nation or organization.
terms.definition: 解密是指正式允许将机密或受控信息提供给合作伙伴国家或组织。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written orders or radio communications.

examples.text: 解密后的文件可传输给盟军。
examples.english: After release, the document can be transmitted to allies.

examples.text: 等待解密授权后再发送信息。
examples.english: Wait for release authorization before sending information.
