terms.definitionEn: A military maneuver or simulated wartime operation involving planning, preparation, and execution that is carried out for the purpose of training and evaluation.
terms.definition: 演习是指为训练和评估目的而进行的军事演练或模拟战争行动，包括计划、准备和执行。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports or briefings.

examples.text: 此次演习旨在提高部队的实战能力。
examples.english: This exercise aims to improve the troops' combat readiness.

examples.text: 根据演习计划，各部门准备就绪。
examples.english: According to the exercise plan, all departments are ready.

terms.definitionEn: A method of airspace control which relies on a combination of previously agreed and promulgated orders and procedures.
terms.definition: 程序管制空域是指依靠预先商定和发布的命令和程序进行的空域控制方法。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and written reports, not typically on radio.

examples.text: 根据程序管制空域的规定，所有飞行员必须提前提交飞行计划。
examples.english: According to the regulations of the procedural control airspace, all pilots must submit their flight plans in advance.

examples.text: 在程序管制空域内，飞行员应遵循预先同意的程序和命令。
examples.english: Within the procedural control airspace, pilots should follow previously agreed procedures and orders.

terms.definitionEn: The navigable airspace between two points, identified to the extent necessary for the application of flight rules.
terms.definition: 航路是指在飞行规则适用范围内，两点之间可供导航的空域。
terms.registerNote: Common in briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 航路上的所有飞行器必须遵守相关的飞行规则。
examples.english: All aircraft on the air route must comply with the relevant flight rules.

examples.text: 我们需要重新评估这条航路的安全性。
examples.english: We need to reassess the safety of this air route.

terms.definitionEn: The senior command and control element in the Air Force theater air control system’s air, cyberspace, and space operations and coordinates with other components and Services. Also called AOC.
terms.definition: 空中作战指挥中心是空军战区空中控制系统中负责空中、网络和太空作战的最高指挥和控制机构，并与其他组成部分和军种协调。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal communications, both written and on radio.

examples.text: 空中作战指挥中心下达了新的任务命令。
examples.english: The air operations center issued new mission orders.

examples.text: 空中作战指挥中心正在协调各部门的行动。
examples.english: The air operations center is coordinating actions among various departments.

terms.definitionEn: The principal air control agency of the theater air control system responsible for the direction and control of air operations directly supporting the ground combat element. Also called ASOC.
terms.term: 空中支援作战指挥中心

equivalents.text: 空中支援作战指挥中心

terms.definition: 空中支援作战指挥中心是战区空中控制系统中负责指挥和控制直接支持地面作战部队的空中行动的主要空中控制机构。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal communications, both written and on radio.

examples.text: 空中支援作战指挥中心负责指导直接支援地面部队的空中行动。
examples.english: The air support operations center is responsible for directing air operations that directly support ground forces.

examples.text: 空中支援作战指挥中心正在与其他组成部分协调。
examples.english: The air support operations center is coordinating with other components.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which surface-to-air missile systems engage air and missile threats. Also called MEZ.
terms.definition: 导弹交战区是指防空导弹系统对空中和导弹威胁进行交战的定义空域。
terms.registerNote: Common in briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 导弹交战区内，地对空导弹系统将拦截来袭的空中和导弹威胁。
examples.english: Within the missile engagement zone, surface-to-air missile systems will intercept incoming air and missile threats.

examples.text: 我们需要重新定义导弹交战区的范围。
examples.english: We need to redefine the range of the missile engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which surface-to-air missiles and aircraft are simultaneously employed to engage air and missile threats. Also called JEZ.
terms.definition: 联合交战区是指同时使用地对空导弹和战斗机来应对空中和导弹威胁的特定空域。
terms.registerNote: Common in briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 联合交战区内，地对空导弹和战斗机将同时对空中和导弹威胁进行打击。
examples.english: Within the joint engagement zone, surface-to-air missiles and fighters will simultaneously engage air and missile threats.

examples.text: 我们需要评估联合交战区的有效性。
examples.english: We need to assess the effectiveness of the joint engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which fighters engage air threats. Also called FEZ.
terms.definition: 战斗机交战区是指战斗机在其中对抗空中威胁的特定空域。
terms.registerNote: Common in briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 战斗机交战区内，战斗机将对空中威胁进行拦截。
examples.english: Within the fighter engagement zone, fighters will intercept air threats.

examples.text: 我们需要扩大战斗机交战区的范围。
examples.english: We need to expand the range of the fighter engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which low- to mediumaltitude surface-to-air missiles engage air and missile threats. Also called LOMEZ.
terms.definition: 低空导弹交战区是指低到中空高度的地对空导弹在其中对抗空中和导弹威胁的特定空域。
terms.registerNote: Common in briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 低空导弹交战区内，低至中高度的地对空导弹将拦截空中和导弹威胁。
examples.english: Within the low-altitude missile engagement zone, low- to medium-altitude surface-to-air missiles will intercept air and missile threats.

examples.text: 我们需要重新评估低空导弹交战区的位置。
examples.english: We need to reassess the location of the low-altitude missile engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which short-range air defense weapons engage air threats and which may be established within a low- or highaltitude missile engagement zone. Also called SHORADEZ.
terms.definition: 短程防空交战区是指短程防空武器在其中对抗空中威胁的特定空域，可能在低空或高空导弹交战区内设立。
terms.registerNote: Common in briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 短程防空交战区内，短程防空武器将对空中威胁进行拦截。
examples.english: Within the short-range air defense engagement zone, short-range air defense weapons will intercept air threats.

examples.text: 我们需要在低空或高空导弹交战区内建立短程防空交战区。
examples.english: We need to establish a short-range air defense engagement zone within a low- or high-altitude missile engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which high-altitude surface-to-air missiles engage air and missile threats. Also called HIMEZ.
terms.definition: 高空导弹交战区是指高空高度的地对空导弹在其中对抗空中和导弹威胁的特定空域。
terms.registerNote: Common in briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 高空导弹交战区内，高空地对空导弹将拦截空中和导弹威胁。
examples.english: Within the high-altitude missile engagement zone, high-altitude surface-to-air missiles will intercept air and missile threats.

examples.text: 我们需要评估高空导弹交战区的有效性。
examples.english: We need to assess the effectiveness of the high-altitude missile engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: 1. overseas — A specifically defined airspace for which air defense must be planned and provided. 2. United States — Airspace of defined dimensions designated by the appropriate agency within which the ready control of airborne vehicles is required in the interest of national security during an air defense emergency.
terms.definition: 防空区域是指需要计划和提供空中防御的特定空域，以确保国家安全。在空中防御紧急情况下，必须控制该区域内的空中飞行器。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 我们需要加强对该防空区域的巡逻
examples.english: We need to strengthen the patrol of this air defense area

examples.text: 该防空区域内发现可疑目标，立即启动防御措施
examples.english: Suspicious targets detected in this air defense area, immediately initiate defense measures

terms.definitionEn: A geographical subdivision of an air defense area.
terms.definition: 防空区是空中防御区域的地理分区。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 第二防空区发现敌机，请求支援
examples.english: Enemy aircraft detected in the second air defense region, requesting support

examples.text: 我们需要加强对该防空区的监控
examples.english: We need to strengthen the monitoring of this air defense region

terms.definitionEn: A geographical subdivision of an air defense region.
terms.definition: 防空区域是空中防御区域的地理划分。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communication.

examples.text: 第一防空区域发现不明飞行物，立即调查
examples.english: Unknown aircraft detected in the first air defense sector, immediately investigate

examples.text: 该防空区域内的目标已被锁定
examples.english: Targets in this air defense sector have been locked

terms.definitionEn: A capability that, when added to the basic identification, friend or foe system, provides the means to transmit, receive, and display selected coded replies. Also called SIF.
terms.definition: 选择性识别特征是一种增强基本识别敌我系统的功能，可以传输、接收和显示选择性编码回复。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical communication and reports.

examples.text: 我们需要启用选择性识别特征来确认身份
examples.english: We need to enable the selective identification feature to confirm identity

examples.text: 选择性识别特征已激活，请确认
examples.english: Selective identification feature activated, please confirm

terms.definitionEn: An identification based on observation and analysis of target behaviors, including location and trajectory, as well as compliance with airspace control measures. Also called procedural ID.
terms.definition: 程序识别是基于对目标行为，包括位置和轨迹的观察和分析，以及遵守空域管制措施的识别方式。
terms.registerNote: Used in analysis and reports.

examples.text: 通过程序识别确认目标身份
examples.english: Confirm target identity through procedural identification

examples.text: 程序识别显示目标符合预期轨迹
examples.english: Procedural identification shows target matches expected trajectory

terms.definitionEn: The process of attaining an accurate characterization of detected objects in the operational environment sufficient to support an engagement decision. Also called CID.
terms.definition: 战斗识别是指在作战环境中准确识别和描述检测到的目标，以支持是否攻击的决策过程。
terms.registerNote: Used in tactical discussions and reports.

examples.text: 战斗识别显示目标为敌方
examples.english: Combat identification shows target is hostile

examples.text: 我们需要更精确的战斗识别能力
examples.english: We need more accurate combat identification capabilities

terms.definitionEn: An aircraft patrol provided over an objective area, the force protected, the critical area of a combat zone, or in an air defense area, for the purpose of intercepting aircraft before they reach their targets. Also called CAP.
terms.definition: 空中巡逻是指战斗机在目标区域、受保护部队、战斗区域的关键区域或防空区域上空进行的巡逻，以在敌机到达目标前进行拦截。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 空中巡逻中发现可疑目标
examples.english: Suspicious target detected during air patrol

examples.text: 空中巡逻队已到达目标区域
examples.english: Air patrol team has reached the target area

terms.definitionEn: In counterdrug operations, contacts that meet the initial identification criteria applicable in the area where the contacts are detected.
terms.definition: 关注目标是指在缉毒行动中，符合初步识别标准的接触目标。
terms.registerNote: Used in counterdrug operations and reports.

examples.text: 该关注目标行为异常，请求进一步监控
examples.english: Behavior of this track of interest is abnormal, requesting further monitoring

examples.text: 关注目标已进入监控范围
examples.english: Track of interest has entered the monitoring range

terms.definitionEn: The detection and reporting of enemy activities by an aircraft.
terms.definition: 空中预警是指通过飞机检测并报告敌方活动。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 空中预警系统发现敌方飞机
examples.english: Airborne early warning system detects enemy aircraft

examples.text: 空中预警机已升空巡逻
examples.english: Airborne early warning aircraft has taken off for patrol

terms.definitionEn: The urgent communication and acknowledgement of time-critical information essential for the preservation of life and/or vital resources.
terms.definition: 紧急警报是指及时通报和确认保护生命和重要资源所必需的紧急信息。
terms.registerNote: Used in urgent radio communication and alerts.

examples.text: 收到紧急警报，敌方导弹正在接近
examples.english: Received threat warning, enemy missiles are approaching

examples.text: 紧急警报已发送，请立即采取行动
examples.english: Threat warning sent, please take immediate action

terms.definitionEn: Direct [active and passive] defensive actions taken to destroy, nullify, or reduce the effectiveness of hostile air and ballistic missile threats against friendly forces and assets. Also called AMD.
terms.definition: 空中和导弹防御是指采取直接行动，摧毁、中和或降低敌方空中和弹道导弹威胁对友军部队和资产的有效性。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 我们需要加强空中和导弹防御以应对潜在威胁。
examples.english: We need to enhance our air and missile defense to counter potential threats.

examples.text: 空中和导弹防御系统已经升级，能够有效拦截来袭导弹。
examples.english: The air and missile defense system has been upgraded to effectively intercept incoming missiles.

terms.definitionEn: The integration of capabilities and overlapping operations to defend the homeland and United States national interests, protect the joint force, and enable freedom of action by negating an enemy’s ability to create adverse effects from their air and missile capabilities. Also called IAMD.
terms.definition: 综合空中和导弹防御是指整合能力和重叠行动，以保卫国家和美国的国家利益，保护联合部队，并通过消除敌方空中和导弹能力的能力来实现行动自由。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 综合空中和导弹防御系统能够提供全面的保护。
examples.english: The integrated air and missile defense system can provide comprehensive protection.

examples.text: 我们需要协调各部门以实现综合空中和导弹防御。
examples.english: We need to coordinate among departments to achieve integrated air and missile defense.

terms.definitionEn: All defensive measures designed to neutralize or destroy enemy forces attempting to penetrate or attack through friendly airspace. Also called DCA.
terms.definition: 防御性反空中是指所有旨在中和或摧毁试图穿透或攻击友方领空的敌方部队的防御措施。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, radio communications.

examples.text: 防御性反空中行动已经启动以应对敌方空袭。
examples.english: Defensive counterair operations have been initiated to counter enemy airstrikes.

examples.text: 我们的防御性反空中能力能够有效保护重要目标。
examples.english: Our defensive counterair capabilities can effectively protect critical targets.

terms.definitionEn: A mission at the theater level that integrates offensive and defensive operations to attain and maintain a desired degree of control of the air and protection by neutralizing or destroying enemy aircraft and missiles, both before and after launch.
terms.definition: 反空中是指在战区层面上整合进攻和防御行动，以获得并保持对空中的一定程度的控制，并通过在发射前和发射后中和或摧毁敌方飞机和导弹来实现保护。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 反空中任务包括攻击和防御两个方面。
examples.english: Counterair missions include both offensive and defensive aspects.

examples.text: 我们需要加强反空中能力以确保空中优势。
examples.english: We need to enhance our counterair capabilities to ensure air superiority.

terms.definitionEn: Employment of defense measures to protect limited areas.
terms.definition: 点防御是指部署防御措施以保护有限区域。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 点防御措施将用于保护关键设施。
examples.english: Point defense measures will be used to protect critical facilities.

examples.text: 我们需要在关键区域部署点防御系统。
examples.english: We need to deploy point defense systems in critical areas.

terms.definitionEn: The component commander with the preponderance of air defense capability and the required command, control, and communications capabilities who is assigned by the joint force commander to plan and execute integrated air defense operations. Also called AADC.
terms.term: 空中和导弹防御区域指挥官

equivalents.text: 空中和导弹防御区域指挥官

terms.definition: 空中和导弹防御区域指挥官是指由联合部队指挥官指定的负责规划和执行综合空中防御行动的指挥官，拥有主要的空中防御能力和必要的指挥、控制和通信能力。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 空中和导弹防御区域指挥官将协调各部门的防御行动。
examples.english: The area air defense commander will coordinate defensive actions among various departments.

examples.text: 空中和导弹防御区域指挥官负责制定防御策略。
examples.english: The area air defense commander is responsible for devising defense strategies.

terms.definitionEn: Commander, subordinate to the area air defense commander, who is responsible for air and missile defenses in the assigned region and exercises authorities as delegated by the area air defense commander. Also called RADC.
terms.term: 空中和导弹防御地区指挥官

equivalents.text: 空中和导弹防御地区指挥官

terms.definition: 空中和导弹防御地区指挥官是指在空中和导弹防御区域指挥官领导下，负责指定区域空中和导弹防御，并行使区域指挥官授权的指挥官。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 空中和导弹防御地区指挥官将监督区域内的防御行动。
examples.english: The regional air defense commander will oversee defensive actions within the region.

examples.text: 空中和导弹防御地区指挥官负责区域内的防御资源分配。
examples.english: The regional air defense commander is responsible for the allocation of defense resources within the region.

terms.definitionEn: Commander, subordinate to an area/regional air defense commander, who is responsible for air and missile defenses in the assigned sector and exercises authorities delegated by the area/regional air defense commander. Also called SADC.
terms.term: 空中和导弹防御区指挥官

equivalents.text: 空中和导弹防御区指挥官

terms.definition: 空中和导弹防御区指挥官是指在区域/地区空中防御指挥官领导下，负责指定扇区空中和导弹防御，并行使区域/地区指挥官授权的指挥官。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 空中和导弹防御区指挥官将管理区域内的防御系统。
examples.english: The sector air defense commander will manage the defense systems within the sector.

examples.text: 空中和导弹防御区指挥官负责区域内的防御部署。
examples.english: The sector air defense commander is responsible for the deployment of defenses within the sector.

terms.definitionEn: A listing of those assets from the critical asset list prioritized by the joint force commander to be defended with the resources available. Also called DAL.
terms.definition: 防御资产清单是指由联合部队指挥官优先选择的资产列表，这些资产将使用可用资源进行防御。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 防御资产清单已经更新，包括所有关键目标。
examples.english: The defended asset list has been updated to include all critical targets.

examples.text: 我们需要根据防御资产清单部署防御资源。
examples.english: We need to deploy defense resources based on the defended asset list.

terms.definitionEn: Defensive measures designed to destroy attacking enemy missiles or to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of such attack. Also called MD.
terms.definition: 导弹防御是指通过摧毁攻击的敌方导弹或减少其有效性来防止敌方导弹攻击的防御措施。
terms.registerNote: Military briefings, reports.

examples.text: 导弹防御系统能够拦截来袭的敌方导弹。
examples.english: The missile defense system can intercept incoming enemy missiles.

examples.text: 我们需要加强导弹防御以应对潜在威胁。
examples.english: We need to enhance missile defense to counter potential threats.

terms.definitionEn: That degree of control of the air by one force that permits the conduct of its operations at a given time and place without prohibitive interference from air and missile threats.
terms.definition: 制空权是指一支部队在特定时间和地点对空中拥有的控制程度，使其能够在无禁止性空中和导弹威胁的情况下进行作战行动。
terms.registerNote: Used in strategic briefings and reports.

examples.text: 我军已建立局部制空权，确保战机安全行动。
examples.english: Our military has established local air superiority, ensuring the safe operation of aircraft.

examples.text: 制空权的争夺是空战的核心，必须优先考虑。
examples.english: The struggle for air superiority is the core of air combat and must be prioritized.

terms.definitionEn: Air action by aircraft against hostile targets that are in close proximity to friendly forces and that require detailed integration of each air mission with the fire and movement of those forces. Also called CAS.
terms.definition: 近距离空中支援是指飞机对敌方目标进行的空中行动，这些目标与友军部队接近，并需要将每次空中任务与友军部队的火力和运动详细整合。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and tactical reports.

examples.text: 近距离空中支援请求已获批准，战机即将到达。
examples.english: Close air support request has been approved, aircraft are about to arrive.

examples.text: 近距离空中支援需要精确的协调和通信。
examples.english: Close air support requires precise coordination and communication.

terms.definitionEn: An officer (aviator/pilot) member of the tactical air control party who, from a forward ground or airborne position, controls aircraft in close air support of ground troops. Also called FAC.
terms.definition: 前进空中控制员是指从前线地面或空中位置控制飞机对地面部队进行近距离空中支援的战术空中控制分队成员。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and tactical reports.

examples.text: 前进空中控制员已标记目标，请战机确认。
examples.english: Forward air controller has marked the target, please confirm, aircraft.

examples.text: 前进空中控制员将指导战机进行精确打击。
examples.english: The forward air controller will guide the aircraft to conduct precise strikes.

terms.definitionEn: A qualified (certified) Service member who, from a forward position, directs the action of combat aircraft engaged in close air support and other offensive air operations. Also called JTAC.
terms.definition: 联合终端攻击控制员是指从前线位置指导参与近距离空中支援和其他进攻性空中行动的战斗机的合格（认证）军人。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and tactical reports.

examples.text: 联合终端攻击控制员已准备好，可以开始引导战机。
examples.english: Joint terminal attack controller is ready, can begin guiding the aircraft.

examples.text: 联合终端攻击控制员将确保打击的精确性和效果。
examples.english: The joint terminal attack controller will ensure the precision and effectiveness of the strike.

terms.definitionEn: A subordinate operational component of a tactical air control system designed to provide air liaison to land forces and for the control of aircraft. Also called TACP.
terms.definition: 战术空中控制分队是指战术空中控制系统的下属作战组成部分，旨在为陆地部队提供空中联络并控制飞机。
terms.registerNote: Used in strategic briefings and reports.

examples.text: 战术空中控制分队已到达前线，准备提供空中支援。
examples.english: Tactical air control party has reached the front line, ready to provide air support.

examples.text: 战术空中控制分队将协调空中和地面部队的行动。
examples.english: The tactical air control party will coordinate the actions of air and ground forces.

terms.definitionEn: The senior tactical air control party member attached to a ground unit who functions as the primary advisor to the ground commander on air power. Also called ALO.
terms.definition: 空中联络官是指派驻地面部队的高级空中战术控制党成员，负责向地面指挥官提供空中力量的主要建议。
terms.registerNote: Used in strategic briefings and reports.

examples.text: 空中联络官正在与地面指挥官讨论空中支援计划。
examples.english: Air liaison officer is discussing air support plans with the ground commander.

examples.text: 空中联络官是地面指挥官的主要空中力量顾问。
examples.english: The air liaison officer is the ground commander's primary advisor on air power.

terms.definitionEn: A joint force commander-validated target or set of targets requiring immediate response because it is a highly lucrative, fleeting target of opportunity or it poses (or will soon pose) a danger to friendly forces. Also called TST.
terms.definition: 时敏目标是指由联合部队指挥官确认的需要立即响应的目标，因为它们是高价值的机会目标或对友军构成威胁。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and tactical reports.

examples.text: 时敏目标已被发现，需要立即处理。
examples.english: Time-sensitive target has been discovered, needs immediate action.

examples.text: 时敏目标的处理需要快速反应和精确打击。
examples.english: Dealing with time-sensitive targets requires rapid response and precise strikes.

terms.definitionEn: An entity that performs a function for the adversary or enemy considered for possible engagement.
terms.definition: 目标是指敌方执行功能的实体，可能被考虑进行攻击。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and tactical reports.

examples.text: 目标已被锁定，请求攻击许可。
examples.english: Target has been locked, requesting permission to engage.

examples.text: 目标的位置和性质需要进一步确认。
examples.english: The location and nature of the target need further confirmation.

terms.definitionEn: The process of selecting and prioritizing targets and matching the appropriate response to them, considering operational requirements and capabilities.
terms.definition: 目标攻击是指根据作战需求和能力，选择和优先处理目标并匹配适当的应对措施的过程。
terms.registerNote: Used in strategic briefings and reports.

examples.text: 目标攻击计划已经制定，即将执行。
examples.english: Targeting plan has been formulated, about to be executed.

examples.text: 目标攻击需要考虑多种因素和限制。
examples.english: Targeting requires considering various factors and constraints.

terms.definitionEn: Unintentional or incidental effect to an entity that would not be a lawful military target in the circumstances ruling at the time.
terms.definition: 附带效应是指对在当时情况下不应被视为合法军事目标的实体造成的非故意或附带影响。
terms.registerNote: Used in strategic briefings and reports.

examples.text: 附带效应需要评估，以避免平民伤亡。
examples.english: Collateral effects need to be assessed to avoid civilian casualties.

examples.text: 附带效应可能影响任务的成功和声誉。
examples.english: Collateral effects may impact the success and reputation of the mission.

terms.definitionEn: The estimate of damage composed of physical and functional damage assessment, as well as target system assessment, resulting from the application of fires. Also called BDA.
terms.definition: 战损评估是指通过火力应用后，对实体的物理和功能损伤以及目标系统进行的评估。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 战损评估显示，敌方雷达站已完全失效。
examples.english: BDA shows the enemy radar station is completely disabled.

examples.text: 请立即进行战损评估并报告结果。
examples.english: Please conduct BDA immediately and report the results.

terms.definitionEn: An area designated by the appropriate commander into which fires or their effects are prohibited. Also called NFA.
terms.definition: 禁火区是指由适当指挥官指定的区域，禁止在该区域内进行射击或产生射击效果。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written orders.

examples.text: 所有部队注意，前方为禁火区，禁止开火。
examples.english: All units, attention, no-fire area ahead, do not fire.

examples.text: 禁火区内发现敌方行动，请求指示。
examples.english: Enemy activity detected in NFA, request instructions.

terms.definitionEn: A location in which specific restrictions are imposed and into which fires that exceed those restrictions will not be delivered without coordination with the establishing headquarters. Also called RFA.
terms.definition: 限制射击区是指在特定限制下设定的位置，超过这些限制的射击将不被执行，除非与设立指挥部进行协调。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written orders.

examples.text: 部队进入限制射击区，请遵守射击限制。
examples.english: Units entering RFA, observe fire restrictions.

examples.text: 限制射击区内发现敌方装甲车，请求授权开火。
examples.english: Enemy armored vehicle detected in RFA, request permission to engage.

terms.definitionEn: A fire support coordination measure established by the land or amphibious force commander to support common objectives within an area of operation, beyond which all fires are coordinated with affected commanders prior to engagement and, short of the line, all fires are coordinated with the establishing commander prior to engagement. Also called FSCL.
terms.definition: 火力支援协调线是由陆地或两栖部队指挥官设立的火力支援协调措施，用于支持作战区域内的共同目标，超出该线的火力需要协调，而线以下的火力需要与设立指挥官协调。
terms.registerNote: Used in written orders and briefings.

examples.text: 火力支援协调线以北，所有火力请求需协调。
examples.english: All fire requests north of FSCL require coordination.

examples.text: 请确认火力支援协调线位置，以避免友军误伤。
examples.english: Confirm FSCL location to prevent friendly fire incidents.

terms.definitionEn: A line beyond which conventional surface-to-surface direct fire and indirect fire support means may fire at any time within the boundaries of the establishing headquarters without additional coordination but does not eliminate the responsibility to coordinate the airspace required to conduct the mission. Also called CFL.
terms.definition: 协调火力线是一条线，超过该线的常规地面到地面的直接火力和间接火力支援手段可以随时在设立指挥部的边界内进行，而无需额外协调，但不排除协调执行任务所需的空域的责任。
terms.registerNote: Used in written orders and briefings.

examples.text: 超过协调火力线后，可自由使用火力打击敌方目标。
examples.english: Fire at will on enemy targets beyond CFL.

examples.text: 请确认协调火力线位置，以便调整火力范围。
examples.english: Confirm CFL location to adjust fire range.

terms.definitionEn: The atmosphere, beginning at the Earth’s surface, extending to the altitude where its effects upon operations become negligible.
terms.definition: 空域是指从地球表面开始，向上延伸到其影响作战效果可以忽略不计的高度的大气层。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 空域内发现多架敌方无人机，请保持戒备。
examples.english: Multiple enemy UAVs detected in air domain, remain vigilant.

examples.text: 空域监控显示，敌方战机正在接近。
examples.english: Air domain monitoring shows enemy fighters approaching.

terms.definitionEn: Defensive measures designed to destroy attacking enemy aircraft or aerodynamic missiles, or to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of such attack. Also called AD.
terms.definition: 空中防空是指通过摧毁敌方进攻的飞机或空气动力导弹，或者减少其攻击效果的防御措施。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 空中防空系统已启动，准备拦截来袭敌机。
examples.english: Air defense systems activated, ready to intercept incoming enemy aircraft.

examples.text: 空中防空部队请报告准备情况。
examples.english: Air defense units, report readiness status.

terms.definitionEn: Defensive measures designed to defeat attacking enemy aircraft and missiles and also negate hostile space systems.
terms.definition: 空天防卫是指防御措施，用于击败敌方进攻的飞机和导弹，同时中和敌方的太空系统。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 空天防卫系统已锁定敌方导弹，准备拦截。
examples.english: Aerospace defense systems locked onto enemy missile, ready to intercept.

examples.text: 空天防卫部队请确认目标信息。
examples.english: Aerospace defense units, confirm target information.

terms.definitionEn: Air operations to perform interdiction conducted at such distances from friendly forces that detailed integration of each air mission with the fire and movement of friendly forces is not required. Also called AI.
terms.definition: 空中打击是指在远离友军的距离上进行的空中作战，以执行拦截任务，无需详细整合每个空中任务与友军的火力和运动。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written orders.

examples.text: 空中打击部队已准备就绪，请求授权出击。
examples.english: Air interdiction forces ready, request permission to engage.

examples.text: 空中打击行动将于30分钟后开始。
examples.english: Air interdiction operation to commence in 30 minutes.

terms.definitionEn: A state of aircraft readiness wherein combat-equipped aircraft are airborne and ready for immediate action to reduce reaction time and to increase survivability.
terms.definition: 空中待命是指战斗机装备完毕后在空中待命，以减少反应时间并提高生存能力。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, indicating a high state of readiness.

examples.text: 空中待命状态下，战机可在5分钟内到达目标区域。
examples.english: In airborne alert status, fighters can reach the target area within 5 minutes.

examples.text: 空中待命以提高反应速度，增强生存能力。
examples.english: Airborne alert to increase response speed and enhance survivability.

terms.definitionEn: That status in which aircraft on the ground/deck are fully serviced and armed, with combat crews in readiness to take off within a specified period of time after receipt of a mission order.
terms.definition: 地面待命是指飞机在陆地或甲板上完全服务和武装完毕，战斗机组人员在接到任务命令后的规定时间内准备好起飞的状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications for status updates.

examples.text: 所有战斗机地面待命，随时准备起飞拦截来袭敌机。
examples.english: All fighter jets are on ground alert, ready to take off and intercept incoming enemy aircraft at any moment.

examples.text: 由于敌方可能突然袭击，指挥部命令所有飞机保持地面待命状态。
examples.english: Due to the possibility of a sudden enemy attack, the command center ordered all aircraft to maintain ground alert status.

terms.definitionEn: In antiterrorism, examining the capabilities, intentions, and activities, past and present, of terrorist organizations, as well as the security environment within which friendly forces operate to determine the level of threat.
terms.definition: 威胁评估是指在反恐怖主义中，通过分析恐怖组织的能力、意图和活动，以及友军所处的安全环境，来确定威胁水平。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings for planning and analysis.

examples.text: 敌方动向不明，需加强威胁评估以制定应对策略。
examples.english: Enemy movements are unclear, need to enhance threat assessment to formulate countermeasures.

examples.text: 根据最新情报，重新进行威胁评估以调整防空计划。
examples.english: Based on the latest intelligence, redo the threat assessment to adjust the air defense plan.

terms.definitionEn: 1. In air and missile defense, a fire control order used to direct or authorize units and/or weapon systems to attack a designated target. See also cease engagement; hold fire. (JP 3-01) 2. To bring the enemy under fire.
terms.definition: 交战是指用于指示或授权单位和/或武器系统攻击指定目标的火力控制命令。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications for orders and directives.

examples.text: 收到命令，立即交战目标007。
examples.english: Received the order, engage target 007 immediately.

examples.text: 根据规则使用武力，命令所有单位交战来袭敌机。
examples.english: According to the rules of engagement, order all units to engage incoming enemy aircraft.

terms.definitionEn: 1. An attack against an air or missile threat. (JP 3-01) 2. A tactical conflict, usually between opposing lower echelon maneuver forces.
terms.definition: 交战是指对空中或导弹威胁进行的攻击，或者是指在对立的下级机动部队之间进行的战术冲突。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings for describing combat situations.

examples.text: 昨晚的交战中，我们成功击落了两架敌机。
examples.english: In last night's engagement, we successfully shot down two enemy aircraft.

examples.text: 根据情报显示，敌方可能展开大规模交战。
examples.english: According to intelligence, the enemy may launch a large-scale engagement.

terms.definitionEn: An authority vested with a joint force commander that may be delegated to a subordinate commander, that permits an engagement decision.
terms.definition: 交战授权是指联合部队指挥官所拥有的权力，可以授权给下属指挥官，允许其做出交战决策。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports for authority delegation.

examples.text: 上级授予我们交战授权，可自行决定是否攻击目标。
examples.english: Higher command has granted us engagement authority, allowing us to decide whether to attack the target.

examples.text: 交战授权已下放到各前线指挥部，以便更快速响应威胁。
examples.english: Engagement authority has been delegated to frontline command centers for faster threat response.

terms.definitionEn: The authority and responsibility to engage targets, which may be delegated to subordinate commanders responsible for operational areas. Also called TEA.
terms.definition: 目标交战授权是指授权和责任去攻击目标，可以下放给负责特定作战区域的下级指挥官。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports for authority delegation.

examples.text: 我们收到了目标交战授权，可以攻击指定目标。
examples.english: We have received target engagement authority and can attack the designated target.

examples.text: 前线指挥官拥有目标交战授权，可自行决定是否攻击来袭敌机。
examples.english: Frontline commanders have target engagement authority and can decide whether to attack incoming enemy aircraft.

terms.definitionEn: An air defense zone established for the protection of key assets or facilities, other than air bases, where weapon systems may be fired at any target not positively recognized as friendly.
terms.definition: 武器自由射击区是为保护关键资产或设施设立的防空区域，除了空军基地，可以对任何未确定为友军的目标开火。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports for zone establishment and management.

examples.text: 进入武器自由射击区后，所有未确认身份的飞机将被视为敌机攻击。
examples.english: Upon entering the weapons free zone, all aircraft with unconfirmed identities will be considered enemy and attacked.

examples.text: 为了保护关键设施，我们建立了武器自由射击区。
examples.english: To protect key facilities, we have established a weapons free zone.

terms.definitionEn: The degree of readiness of weapons that can be launched to carry out an assigned task, normally expressed in numbers of weapons and numbers of minutes.
terms.definition: 武器准备状态是指武器系统能够执行分配任务的准备程度，通常用武器数量和准备时间来表示。
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings for readiness updates.

examples.text: 目前武器准备状态为30分钟内可发射10枚导弹。
examples.english: Current weapons readiness state is 10 missiles ready to launch within 30 minutes.

examples.text: 根据任务要求，武器准备状态需要提升到15分钟内可发射15枚导弹。
examples.english: According to mission requirements, the weapons readiness state needs to be elevated to 15 missiles ready to launch within 15 minutes.

terms.definitionEn: Those minimum actions, including the use of armed force, sufficient to bring a situation under control or to defend against a hostile act or hostile intent.
terms.definition: 最小武力是指足以控制局势或防御敌对行为或意图的最低行动，包括使用武力。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports for force application guidelines.

examples.text: 根据规则使用武力，我们只能使用最小武力来制止敌方行动。
examples.english: According to the rules of engagement, we can only use minimum force to stop enemy actions.

examples.text: 在执行任务时，必须遵守最小武力原则，避免造成不必要的伤亡。
examples.english: When executing missions, the principle of minimum force must be followed to avoid unnecessary casualties.

terms.definitionEn: An operation planned to demonstrate United States resolve that involves increased visibility of United States deployed forces in an attempt to defuse a specific situation that, if allowed to continue, may be detrimental to United States interests or national objectives.
terms.definition: 展示武力是指计划展示美国决心的行动，涉及增加美国部署部队的可见度，以缓解可能对美国利益或国家目标有害的特定局势。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports for deterrence strategies.

examples.text: 为了震慑敌方，我们决定进行一次展示武力的演习。
examples.english: To deter the enemy, we decided to conduct a show of force exercise.

examples.text: 展示武力可以有效地展示我们的决心和能力，迫使敌方重新考虑其行动。
examples.english: A show of force can effectively demonstrate our resolve and capabilities, forcing the enemy to reconsider its actions.

terms.definitionEn: A weapon, device, or munition that is explicitly designed and primarily employed to incapacitate personnel or materiel immediately, while minimizing fatalities, permanent injury to personnel, and undesired damage to property in the target area or environment. Also called NLW.
terms.definition: 非致命武器是指专门设计用于立即使人员或物资失效，同时最小化人员伤亡和目标区域或环境中不必要的财产损害的武器、设备或弹药。
terms.registerNote: Military jargon, used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 非致命武器已成功用于控制暴乱人群，无人员伤亡。
examples.english: Nonlethal weapons were successfully used to control the rioting crowd, with no casualties.

examples.text: 部队在演习中使用了非致命武器，有效遏制了敌方进攻。
examples.english: Troops used nonlethal weapons in the exercise, effectively halting the enemy's advance.

terms.definitionEn: A fire control order used to direct air defense units to stop tactical action against a specified target.
terms.definition: 停止射击是指用于指示防空部队停止对指定目标采取战术行动的火力控制命令。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and fire control orders.

examples.text: 收到命令，立即停止射击，等待进一步指示。
examples.english: Order received, cease engagement immediately, await further instructions.

examples.text: 由于友军误入区域，需立即停止射击，避免误伤。
examples.english: Due to friendly forces entering the area, cease engagement immediately to avoid friendly fire.

terms.definitionEn: An emergency fire control order to stop firing on a designated target and destroy missiles in flight.
terms.definition: 停止射击是指紧急火力控制命令，停止对指定目标的射击并摧毁在飞行中的导弹。
terms.registerNote: Emergency order, used in radio communication.

examples.text: 发现己方人员，立即停止射击，销毁已发射的导弹。
examples.english: Friendly personnel detected, hold fire immediately, destroy missiles in flight.

examples.text: 误判目标，立即停止射击，重新锁定敌方飞机。
examples.english: Target misidentified, hold fire immediately, reacquire enemy aircraft.

terms.definitionEn: A specific region into which any weapon system may fire without additional coordination with the establishing headquarters. Also called FFA.
terms.definition: 自由射击区是指任何武器系统都可以在不需要与设立总部进行额外协调的情况下向其开火的特定区域。
terms.registerNote: Used in tactical planning and fire control orders.

examples.text: 自由射击区内的所有目标均可直接攻击，无需协调。
examples.english: All targets within the free-fire area may be engaged directly without coordination.

examples.text: 部队进入自由射击区，可使用各种武器系统攻击敌方目标。
examples.english: Troops enter the free-fire area, may use various weapon systems to engage enemy targets.

terms.definitionEn: An immediately available, prearranged barrier of fire designed to impede enemy movement across defensive lines or areas. Also called FPF.
terms.definition: 最后防护火力是指设计用于阻止敌军穿越防御线或区域的立即可用、预先安排的火力屏障。
terms.registerNote: Used in defensive planning and fire control orders.

examples.text: 最后防护火力已准备就绪，可随时对敌方进行阻击。
examples.english: Final protective fire is ready, can engage the enemy at any time.

examples.text: 部队撤退时，最后防护火力有效阻止了敌方的追击。
examples.english: Final protective fire effectively halted the enemy's pursuit as our troops withdrew.

terms.definitionEn: Fire delivered on a target using the target itself as a point of aim for either the weapon or the director.
terms.definition: 直接射击是指以目标本身作为瞄准点，直接对目标进行射击的火力行动。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, indicating a specific type of fire.

examples.text: 直接射击命中敌方装甲车，请求支援。
examples.english: Direct fire hit enemy armored vehicle, requesting support.

examples.text: 直接射击有效，已摧毁敌方防御工事。
examples.english: Direct fire effective, enemy defensive positions destroyed.

terms.definitionEn: Military action involving the use of electromagnetic energy to control the electromagnetic spectrum or to attack the enemy. Also called EW.
terms.definition: 电磁战是指利用电磁能量控制电磁频谱或攻击敌人的军事行动。
terms.registerNote: Military jargon, used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 电磁战部队正在干扰敌方通信，破坏其指挥系统。
examples.english: Electromagnetic warfare units are jamming enemy communications, disrupting their command system.

examples.text: 通过电磁战手段，成功压制了敌方的雷达探测能力。
examples.english: By employing electromagnetic warfare, we successfully suppressed the enemy's radar detection capabilities.

terms.definitionEn: Division of electromagnetic warfare using electromagnetic energy to attack personnel, facilities, or equipment with the intent of deceiving, disrupting, degrading, or destroying enemy combat capability and is considered a form of fires. Also called EA.
terms.definition: 电磁攻击是指利用电磁能量攻击人员、设施或装备，以欺骗、干扰、削弱或摧毁敌方作战能力的电磁战分支。
terms.registerNote: Used in tactical planning and reports.

examples.text: 电磁攻击已导致敌方设备损坏，影响其作战能力。
examples.english: Electromagnetic attack has caused damage to enemy equipment, impacting their combat effectiveness.

examples.text: 通过电磁攻击，成功迫使敌方战机降落。
examples.english: By conducting an electromagnetic attack, we successfully forced the enemy aircraft to land.

terms.definitionEn: Division of electromagnetic warfare that protects personnel, facilities, and equipment from any effects of friendly or enemy use of the electromagnetic spectrum. Also called EP.
terms.definition: 电磁防护是指保护人员、设施和装备免受友军或敌军使用电磁频谱影响的电磁战分支。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and planning.

examples.text: 电磁防护措施有效保护了我方设备，免受敌方干扰。
examples.english: Electromagnetic protection measures effectively safeguarded our equipment from enemy interference.

examples.text: 部署电磁防护设备，确保通信系统正常运行。
examples.english: Deploy electromagnetic protection equipment to ensure normal operation of communication systems.

terms.definitionEn: Division of electromagnetic warfare involving actions tasked by, or under direct control of, a commander that searches for, intercepts, identifies, and locates electromagnetic energy. Also called ES.
terms.definition: 电磁支持是指在指挥官的任务或直接控制下，搜索、截获、识别和定位电磁能量的电磁战分支。
terms.registerNote: Used in tactical planning and reports.

examples.text: 电磁支持小组正在搜索和定位敌方通信信号。
examples.english: Electromagnetic support team is searching for and locating enemy communication signals.

examples.text: 通过电磁支持，成功截获了敌方的情报传输。
examples.english: By employing electromagnetic support, we successfully intercepted the enemy's intelligence transmission.

terms.definitionEn: Any electromagnetic disturbance that interrupts, obstructs, or otherwise degrades or limits the effective performance of electromagnetic spectrumdependent systems and electrical equipment. Also called EMI.
terms.definition: 电磁干扰是指任何干扰、阻碍或降低电磁频谱依赖系统和电气设备有效性能的电磁干扰。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical briefings and reports.

examples.text: 我们需要评估敌方可能的电磁干扰来源。
examples.english: We need to assess potential sources of enemy EMI.

examples.text: 电磁干扰可能导致雷达系统失效。
examples.english: EMI could cause radar systems to fail.

terms.definitionEn: Service actions to exploit, attack, protect, and manage the electromagnetic environment. Also called EMSO.
terms.definition: 电磁频谱作战是指服务行动以利用、攻击、保护和管理电磁环境。
terms.registerNote: Used in strategic planning and high-level briefings.

examples.text: 电磁频谱作战是现代战争的重要组成部分。
examples.english: EMSO is an important part of modern warfare.

examples.text: 我们必须加强电磁频谱作战能力以保持战斗优势。
examples.english: We must enhance our EMSO capabilities to maintain combat superiority.

terms.definitionEn: The operational, engineering, and administrative procedures to plan and coordinate operations within the electromagnetic environment.
terms.definition: 电磁频谱管理是指在电磁环境中规划和协调作战的运营、工程和行政程序。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical and operational reports.

examples.text: 电磁频谱管理确保了我们的通信系统的有效运行。
examples.english: ESM ensures the effective operation of our communication systems.

examples.text: 我们需要制定详细的电磁频谱管理计划。
examples.english: We need to develop a detailed ESM plan.

terms.definitionEn: The ability of systems, equipment, and devices that use the electromagnetic spectrum to operate in their intended environments without causing or suffering unacceptable or unintentional degradation because of electromagnetic radiation or response.
terms.definition: 电磁兼容性是指系统、设备和设备在预期环境中运行的能力，不会因电磁辐射或响应而导致不可接受或意外的性能降级。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical evaluations and reports.

examples.text: 我们的设备必须满足电磁兼容性标准。
examples.english: Our equipment must meet EMC standards.

examples.text: 电磁兼容性测试显示设备性能良好。
examples.english: EMC testing shows the equipment performs well.

terms.definitionEn: The sum of electromagnetic emissions from all sources that the joint force encounters in a particular operational area. Also called EME.
terms.definition: 电磁环境是指在特定作战区域内，联合部队遇到的所有电磁发射的总和。
terms.registerNote: Used in situational reports and briefings.

examples.text: 电磁环境的变化可能影响我们的导航系统。
examples.english: Changes in the EME may affect our navigation systems.

examples.text: 我们需要监测电磁环境以确保操作安全。
examples.english: We need to monitor the EME to ensure operational safety.

terms.definitionEn: The intentional insertion of electromagnetic energy into transmission paths in any manner, with the objective of deceiving operators or causing confusion.
terms.definition: 电磁侵入是指故意将电磁能量插入传输路径，目的是欺骗操作员或制造混乱。
terms.registerNote: Used in security briefings and reports.

examples.text: 敌方可能尝试通过电磁侵入破坏我们的通信。
examples.english: The enemy may attempt to disrupt our communications through EMI.

examples.text: 电磁侵入可能导致系统错误和数据丢失。
examples.english: EMI could cause system errors and data loss.

terms.definitionEn: Radiation introduced into the devices or systems for the purpose of learning the functions and operational capabilities of the devices or systems.
terms.definition: 电磁探测是指向设备或系统中引入辐射，以了解其功能和运行能力。
terms.registerNote: Used in intelligence reports and technical briefings.

examples.text: 电磁探测可以帮助我们了解敌方设备的功能。
examples.english: EMP can help us understand the functions of enemy equipment.

examples.text: 我们需要进行电磁探测以评估敌方雷达的能力。
examples.english: We need to conduct EMP to assess the capabilities of enemy radar.

terms.definitionEn: A strong burst of electromagnetic radiation which may produce damaging current and voltage surges. Also called EMP.
terms.definition: 电磁脉冲是一种强烈的电磁辐射爆发，可能产生破坏性的电流和电压冲击。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical evaluations and security briefings.

examples.text: 电磁脉冲可能对我们的电子设备造成严重破坏。
examples.english: EMP could cause severe damage to our electronic devices.

examples.text: 我们需要加强对电磁脉冲的防御以保护关键系统。
examples.english: We need to enhance our EMP defenses to protect critical systems.

terms.definitionEn: The controlled use of electromagnetic, acoustic, or other emitters to optimize command and control capabilities and minimize detection by enemy sensors, mutual interference among friendly systems, and enemy interference with the ability to execute a military deception plan. Also called EMCON.
terms.definition: 电磁管制是指控制使用电磁、声学或其他发射器，以优化指挥控制能力，并最小化敌方传感器的检测、友军系统的相互干扰以及敌方对军事欺骗计划的干扰。
terms.registerNote: Used in operational orders and briefings.

examples.text: 电磁管制措施可以减少我们被敌方探测到的风险。
examples.english: EMCON measures can reduce the risk of being detected by the enemy.

examples.text: 我们需要遵守电磁管制规定以保持通信安全。
examples.english: We need to adhere to EMCON regulations to ensure communication security.

terms.definitionEn: This portion of communications security designed to deny unauthorized persons information of value as a result of intercept and analysis of compromising emanations from cryptographic equipment and telecommunications systems.
terms.definition: 发射安全是指通信保密的一部分，旨在防止未经授权的人通过截获和分析密码设备和通信系统的泄露信息而获取有价值的信息。
terms.registerNote: Used in security protocols and reports.

examples.text: 发射安全是确保通信保密的重要环节。
examples.english: Emission security is crucial for ensuring communication secrecy.

examples.text: 我们需要定期检查发射安全以防止信息泄露。
examples.english: We need to regularly check emission security to prevent information leaks.

terms.definitionEn: Protective measures to deny unauthorized access to information of value derived from use of communications systems. Also called COMSEC.
terms.definition: 通信保密是指采取保护措施，防止未经授权的人员访问通过通信系统获得的有价值信息。
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and briefings.

examples.text: 我们必须确保通信保密以防止信息泄露。
examples.english: We must ensure communications security to prevent information leakage.

examples.text: 在执行任务时，请始终遵守通信保密的规定。
examples.english: Always follow the communications security regulations during mission execution.

terms.definitionEn: That portion of communications security designed to protect communications from interception and exploitation by means other than cryptanalysis.
terms.definition: 传输安全是指通信保密的一部分，旨在防止通信被截获和利用，除了密码分析。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 传输安全是保证信息安全的重要措施。
examples.english: Transmission security is an important measure to ensure information security.

examples.text: 我们需要加强传输安全以防止信号被截获。
examples.english: We need to enhance transmission security to prevent signal interception.

terms.definitionEn: A list of TABOO, PROTECTED, and GUARDED functions, nets, and frequencies, sorted by time and location, and limited to the minimum number of frequencies necessary for friendly forces to accomplish objectives. Also called JRFL.
terms.definition: 联合受限频率表是指按时间和地点排序的禁用、受保护和受限功能、网络和频率的列表，仅限于友军完成目标所需的最少频率数量。
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and liaison.

examples.text: 联合受限频率表需要定期更新以适应新的作战环境。
examples.english: The joint restricted frequency list needs to be updated regularly to adapt to new operational environments.

examples.text: 请核对联合受限频率表以避免频率冲突。
examples.english: Please verify the joint restricted frequency list to avoid frequency conflicts.

terms.definitionEn: Friendly frequencies used for a particular operation, identified and protected for a period of time to prevent them from being inadvertently jammed by friendly forces while active electromagnetic warfare operations are directed against hostile forces.
terms.definition: 保护频率是指在特定操作中使用的友军频率，在一段时间内被识别和保护，以防止在敌对力量进行电磁战操作时被友军误意干扰。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 保护频率对于关键通信任务至关重要。
examples.english: PROTECTED frequencies are crucial for critical communication tasks.

examples.text: 我们需要确保保护频率不被干扰。
examples.english: We need to ensure that PROTECTED frequencies are not interfered with.

terms.definitionEn: The dynamic planning, directing, monitoring, and assessing of operations in the electromagnetic spectrum in support of the commander’s concept of the operation. Also called EMBM.
terms.definition: 电磁战管控是指动态规划、指导、监控和评估电磁频谱操作，以支持指挥官的作战概念。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 电磁战管控有助于提高作战效率。
examples.english: Electromagnetic battle management helps improve combat efficiency.

examples.text: 在作战中，我们需要加强电磁战管控。
examples.english: We need to enhance electromagnetic battle management during combat.

terms.definitionEn: The characteristics of a system that cause it to suffer a performance degradation when subjected to electromagnetic environmental effects.
terms.definition: 电磁脆弱性是指系统在遭受电磁环境影响时性能下降的特性。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and briefings.

examples.text: 我们需要评估系统的电磁脆弱性以采取适当的防护措施。
examples.english: We need to assess the system's electromagnetic vulnerability to take appropriate protective measures.

examples.text: 电磁脆弱性可能导致通信中断。
examples.english: Electromagnetic vulnerability may cause communication interruptions.

terms.definitionEn: Action taken to protect personnel, facilities, and equipment against undesirable effects of electromagnetic energy.
terms.definition: 电磁加固是采取行动保护人员、设施和设备免受不良电磁能量的影响。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and briefings.

examples.text: 电磁加固可以减少系统受电磁干扰的影响。
examples.english: Electromagnetic hardening can reduce the impact of electromagnetic interference on systems.

examples.text: 我们需要对关键设备进行电磁加固。
examples.english: We need to electromagnetic hardening for critical equipment.

terms.definitionEn: The employment of devices and techniques that impair the effectiveness of enemy actions.
terms.definition: 对抗措施是指使用设备和技术来降低敌方行动的有效性。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and reports.

examples.text: 我们需要部署对抗措施以应对敌方威胁。
examples.english: We need to deploy countermeasures to counter enemy threats.

examples.text: 对抗措施可以有效降低敌方攻击的效果。
examples.english: Countermeasures can effectively reduce the effectiveness of enemy attacks.

terms.definitionEn: A device or technique employing electrooptical-infrared materials or technology to impair the effectiveness of enemy activity.
terms.definition: 电光红外反制是指使用电光红外材料或技术来降低敌方行动的有效性。
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and briefings.

examples.text: 电光红外反制可以有效对付敌方的红外制导武器。
examples.english: Electro-optical-infrared countermeasures can effectively counter enemy infrared-guided weapons.

examples.text: 我们需要加强电光红外反制能力。
examples.english: We need to enhance our electro-optical-infrared countermeasure capabilities.

terms.definitionEn: That degree of control in the electromagnetic spectrum that permits the conduct of operations at a given time and place without prohibitive interference, while affecting the threat’s ability to do the same.
terms.definition: 电磁频谱优势是指在特定时间和地点控制电磁频谱，使己方能够有效行动而不受干扰，同时影响敌方的同类能力。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 电磁频谱优势是现代战场上的关键能力。
examples.english: Electromagnetic spectrum superiority is a key capability on the modern battlefield.

examples.text: 我们需要争取电磁频谱优势以取得作战优势。
examples.english: We need to strive for electromagnetic spectrum superiority to gain a combat advantage.

terms.definitionEn: An air defense zone established around an air base and limited to the engagement envelope of short-range air defense weapons systems defending that base.
terms.definition: 基地防空区是指在空军基地周围建立的防空区域，限制在短程防空武器系统的攻击范围内。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 基地防空区内禁止无关人员进入，请各单位严格执行。
examples.english: Unauthorized personnel are prohibited within the base defense zone, all units must strictly comply.

examples.text: 基地防空区的雷达系统正在运行，请注意警惕。
examples.english: The base defense zone's radar systems are operational, please remain vigilant.

terms.definitionEn: A line that delineates the surface area of a base for the purpose of facilitating coordination and deconfliction of operations between adjacent units, formations, or areas.
terms.definition: 基地界限是指划定基地表面区域的线，用于协调和避免相邻单位、部队或区域之间的冲突。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings, radio communication, and written reports.

examples.text: 基地界限内禁止吸烟，请各单位严格遵守。
examples.english: Smoking is prohibited within the base boundary, all units must strictly comply.

examples.text: 基地界限外有可疑人员活动，请立即报告。
examples.english: There is suspicious activity outside the base boundary, please report immediately.

terms.definitionEn: A collection of bases, geographically grouped for mutual protection and ease of command and control.
terms.definition: 基地群是指地理上为相互保护和便于指挥控制而组合在一起的基地集合。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and written reports.

examples.text: 基地群之间需要加强协调，以提高整体防御能力。
examples.english: Coordination between base clusters needs to be strengthened to enhance overall defensive capabilities.

examples.text: 基地群的指挥中心正在召开联席会议。
examples.english: The base cluster operations center is holding a joint meeting.

terms.definitionEn: A command and control facility that serves as the base cluster commander’s focal point for defense and security of the base cluster. Also called BCOC.
terms.definition: 基地群作战指挥中心是指基地群指挥官用于防御和保障基地群的指挥控制设施，也称为BCOC。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings, radio communication, and written reports.

examples.text: 基地群作战指挥中心正在组织防空演练。
examples.english: The base cluster operations center is organizing an air defense exercise.

examples.text: 基地群作战指挥中心接到报告，有可疑飞行器接近。
examples.english: The base cluster operations center received a report of a suspicious aircraft approaching.

terms.definitionEn: That part of security concerned with physical measures designed to safeguard personnel; to prevent unauthorized access to equipment, installations, material, and documents; and to safeguard them against espionage, sabotage, damage, and theft.
terms.definition: 物理安全是指通过物理措施防止未经授权的访问，保护人员、设备、设施、材料和文件免受间谍活动、破坏、损坏和盗窃。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings, radio communication, and written reports.

examples.text: 物理安全措施包括围墙、哨兵和监控系统。
examples.english: Physical security measures include fences, sentries, and monitoring systems.

examples.text: 物理安全检查发现了一个漏洞，请立即修复。
examples.english: A physical security check discovered a vulnerability, please fix it immediately.

terms.definitionEn: 1. Measures taken by a military unit, activity, or installation to protect itself against all acts designed to, or which may, impair its effectiveness. (JP 3-10) 2. A condition that results from the establishment and maintenance of protective measures that ensure a state of inviolability from hostile acts or influences. (JP 3-10) 3. Measures taken to prevent unauthorized persons from having access to information safeguarded in the interest of the nation.
terms.definition: 安全是指军事单位采取的措施，以保护自己免受任何可能损害其有效性的行为，同时也指通过建立和维护保护措施来确保免受敌对行为或影响的状态。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings, radio communication, and written reports.

examples.text: 安全措施包括人员培训、设备维护和定期检查。
examples.english: Security measures include personnel training, equipment maintenance, and regular inspections.

examples.text: 安全警报已经发出，请各单位立即采取行动。
examples.english: A security alert has been issued, all units must take immediate action.

terms.definitionEn: A highly mobile and dedicated security force with the capability to defeat Level I and II threats in a joint security area. Also called MSF.
terms.definition: 机动安全力量是一种高度机动且专门用于安全的部队，能够在联合安全区内击败一级和二级威胁。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and written reports.

examples.text: 机动安全力量正在巡逻，请注意配合。
examples.english: The mobile security force is on patrol, please cooperate.

examples.text: 机动安全力量接到报告，有可疑人员接近基地。
examples.english: The mobile security force received a report of suspicious individuals approaching the base.

terms.definitionEn: A rapidly deployable, air-ground, mobile combat unit with appropriate combat support and combat service support assets assigned to, and capable of, defeating Level III threats, including combined arms. Also called TCF.
terms.definition: 战术作战部队是一种能够快速部署的空地两栖机动战斗单位，配备适当的战斗支援和战斗服务支援资产，能够击败三级威胁，包括联合作战。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings, radio communication, and written reports.

examples.text: 战术作战部队正在准备出发，请确保一切就绪。
examples.english: The tactical combat force is preparing to depart, please ensure everything is ready.

examples.text: 战术作战部队接到命令，前往支援友军。
examples.english: The tactical combat force received orders to proceed and support allied forces.

terms.definitionEn: A specific area to facilitate protection of joint bases and their connecting lines of communications that support joint operations. Also called JSA.
terms.definition: 联合安全区是一个特定区域，用于便利保护支持联合行动的联合基地及其连接的交通线。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings, radio communication, and written reports.

examples.text: 联合安全区内禁止无关人员进入，请各单位严格执行。
examples.english: Unauthorized personnel are prohibited within the joint security area, all units must strictly comply.

examples.text: 联合安全区的巡逻队发现了可疑人员，请立即增援。
examples.english: The joint security area's patrol team discovered suspicious individuals, please provide immediate reinforcement.

terms.definitionEn: The officer responsible for coordinating the overall security of the operational area in accordance with joint force commander directives and priorities. Also called JSC.
terms.definition: 联合安全协调员是负责根据联合部队指挥官的指示和优先事项协调作战区域整体安全的军官。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings, radio communication, and written reports.

examples.text: 联合安全协调员正在召开会议，讨论安全措施。
examples.english: The joint security coordinator is holding a meeting to discuss security measures.

examples.text: 联合安全协调员接到报告，有可疑活动在安全区内。
examples.english: The joint security coordinator received a report of suspicious activity within the security area.

terms.definitionEn: A joint operations center tailored to assist the joint security coordinator in meeting the security requirements in the joint operational area. Also called JSCC.
terms.definition: 联合安全协调中心是一个为协助联合安全协调员满足联合作战区域安全需求而定制的联合行动中心。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 联合安全协调中心已启动，确保各部队协同行动。
examples.english: The JSCC has been activated to ensure coordinated actions among all units.

examples.text: 联合安全协调中心正在评估当前安全形势。
examples.english: The JSCC is currently assessing the present security situation.

terms.definitionEn: A Department of Defense intelligence threat assessment of the level of terrorist threat faced by United States personnel and interests in a foreign nation; the levels are expressed as LOW, MODERATE, SIGNIFICANT, and HIGH.
terms.definition: 恐怖主义威胁等级是美国国防部情报部门对美国人员和利益在外国面临的恐怖主义威胁水平的评估，等级分为低、中、高和极高。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 恐怖主义威胁等级已上升，请提高警惕。
examples.english: The terrorism threat level has increased, please heighten vigilance.

examples.text: 根据恐怖主义威胁等级，采取相应的安全措施。
examples.english: According to the terrorism threat level, take appropriate security measures.

terms.definitionEn: In antiterrorism, a continual process of compiling and examining all available information concerning activities by terrorist groups which could target a facility.
terms.definition: 威胁分析是反恐怖主义中的一个持续过程，涉及收集和检查所有关于可能针对设施的恐怖主义组织活动的可用信息。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 威胁分析显示，恐怖分子可能发动袭击。
examples.english: Threat analysis indicates that terrorists might launch an attack.

examples.text: 定期进行威胁分析，以评估潜在威胁。
examples.english: Conduct threat analysis regularly to assess potential threats.

terms.definitionEn: A weapon fabricated or emplaced in an unconventional manner incorporating destructive, lethal, noxious, pyrotechnic, or incendiary chemicals. Also called IED.
terms.definition: 简易爆炸装置是一种以非传统方式制造或安放的武器，包含具有破坏性、致命性、有毒性、烟火性或引火性的化学物质。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 发现简易爆炸装置，请立即疏散人员。
examples.english: An IED has been found, please evacuate personnel immediately.

examples.text: 简易爆炸装置已成功拆除，危险解除。
examples.english: The IED has been successfully disarmed, danger averted.

terms.definitionEn: A device placed or fabricated in an improvised manner on a vehicle incorporating destructive, lethal, noxious, pyrotechnic, or incendiary chemicals and designed to destroy, incapacitate, harass, or distract. Also called VBIED.
terms.definition: 车载简易爆炸装置是一种在车辆上以非传统方式安放或制造的装置，包含具有破坏性、致命性、有毒性、烟火性或引火性的化学物质，并旨在摧毁、使无力行动、骚扰或转移注意力。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 车载简易爆炸装置可能用于自杀式袭击。
examples.english: A VBIED might be used for a suicide attack.

examples.text: 发现可疑车辆，疑似车载简易爆炸装置。
examples.english: A suspicious vehicle has been spotted, possibly a VBIED.

terms.definitionEn: The process to detect, locate, access, diagnose, render safe/neutralize, recover, exploit, and dispose of explosive or improvised explosive threats. Also called EOD.
terms.definition: 爆炸物处理是指检测、定位、接触、诊断、拆除或中和、回收、利用和处置爆炸性或简易爆炸装置威胁的过程。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 爆炸物处理小组正在拆除炸弹。
examples.english: The EOD team is disarming the bomb.

examples.text: 爆炸物处理完成，现场安全。
examples.english: EOD complete, the scene is safe.

terms.definitionEn: 1. Any material posing a potential threat that contains an explosive component. (JP 3-15) 2. In explosive ordnance disposal, a condition where danger exists because explosives are present that may react in a mishap with potential unacceptable effects to people, property, operational capability, or the environment. Also called EH.
terms.definition: 爆炸性威胁指任何包含爆炸成分可能构成潜在威胁的物质，或者由于爆炸物存在可能导致事故并对人员、财产、作战能力或环境造成不可接受影响的情况。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 检测到爆炸性威胁，请保持距离。
examples.english: An explosive hazard has been detected, please keep your distance.

examples.text: 爆炸性威胁已清除，可以安全通过。
examples.english: The explosive hazard has been cleared, safe to pass.

terms.definitionEn: All munitions and improvised or clandestine explosive devices, containing explosives, propellants, nuclear fission or fusion materials, and biological and chemical agents.
terms.definition: 爆炸性武器包括所有含有炸药、推进剂、核裂变或核聚变材料以及生物和化学制剂的军械和简易或秘密爆炸装置。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 爆炸性武器可能隐藏在行李中。
examples.english: Explosive ordnance might be hidden in luggage.

examples.text: 发现爆炸性武器，请立即汇报。
examples.english: Explosive ordnance found, report immediately.

terms.definitionEn: The organization, integration, and synchronization of capabilities that enable offensive, defensive, and support activities across the competition continuum to defeat improvised explosive devices. Also called C-IED.
terms.definition: 反简易爆炸装置是指组织、整合和协调能力，使得在竞争连续体的进攻、防御和支援活动中能够打击简易爆炸装置。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 反简易爆炸装置系统已部署，提高防御能力。
examples.english: The C-IED system has been deployed, enhancing defensive capabilities.

examples.text: 反简易爆炸装置训练将于下周进行。
examples.english: C-IED training will take place next week.

terms.definitionEn: Measures taken before, during, and/or after a hostile action or natural or manmade disasters to reduce the probability of damage and minimize its effects. Also called ADC.
terms.definition: 区域损害控制是在敌对行动或自然灾害前后采取的措施，以减少损坏的概率并最小化其影响。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 区域损害控制措施已启动，减少灾害影响。
examples.english: Area damage control measures have been activated to minimize disaster impact.

examples.text: 区域损害控制团队正在评估损害程度。
examples.english: The ADC team is assessing the extent of the damage.

terms.definitionEn: The protection provided to a group of individuals that permits relaxation of individual chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear protection. Also called COLPRO.
terms.definition: 集体防护是指为一群人提供的保护，使得可以放松个人对化学、生物、辐射或核威胁的防护。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio and written reports for chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear threats.

examples.text: 集体防护已经启动，请所有人员进入指定区域
examples.english: Collective protection has been activated, please enter the designated area

examples.text: 集体防护设备需要定期检查和维护
examples.english: Collective protection equipment needs regular inspection and maintenance

terms.definitionEn: The personal clothing and equipment provided to all military, government civilians, and contractors authorized to accompany the force required to protect an individual from chemical, biological, and radiological hazards and some nuclear hazards. Also called IPE.
terms.definition: 个人防护装备是指为所有军事人员、政府平民和授权随军的承包商提供的个人服装和设备，用于保护个人免受化学、生物和辐射危害以及部分核危害。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and written reports for equipment distribution and checks.

examples.text: 个人防护装备已经发放，请确保正确佩戴
examples.english: Individual protective equipment has been issued, ensure proper wear

examples.text: 检查个人防护装备是否完好无损
examples.english: Check if the individual protective equipment is intact

terms.definitionEn: A system of protection against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear contamination in which personnel are required to wear protective clothing and equipment appropriate to the threat level, work rate imposed by the mission or environment. Also called MOPP.
terms.definition: 任务导向防护姿态是一种防护系统，要求人员根据威胁等级、任务或环境施加的工作强度，穿戴适当的防护服装和设备以防止化学、生物、辐射和核污染。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications for protective measures.

examples.text: 根据任务要求，我们需要采取任务导向防护姿态
examples.english: Based on the mission requirements, we need to adopt a mission-oriented protective posture

examples.text: 任务导向防护姿态下，所有人员必须穿戴防护服装
examples.english: Under mission-oriented protective posture, all personnel must wear protective clothing

collocations: 采取任务导向防护姿态

terms.definitionEn: Department of Defense and non-Department of Defense networked assets and facilities essential to project, support, and sustain military forces and operations worldwide. Also called DCI.
terms.definition: 防御关键基础设施指国防部和非国防部网络资产和设施，这些资产和设施对全球投送、支援和维持军事力量和行动至关重要。
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and radio communications for infrastructure protection.

examples.text: 防御关键基础设施受到攻击，请立即报告
examples.english: Defense critical infrastructure is under attack, report immediately

examples.text: 保护防御关键基础设施是我们的首要任务
examples.english: Protecting defense critical infrastructure is our top priority

collocations: 保护防御关键基础设施
防御关键基础设施受到攻击
防御关键基础设施的安全

terms.definitionEn: A facility located outside the United States and its territories with little or no permanent United States presence that is maintained by periodic Service, contractor, or host nation support. Also called CSL.
terms.definition: 合作安全地点是指位于美国及其领土之外、没有或几乎没有永久美国存在的设施，由定期的军种、承包商或东道国支持维护。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications for location identification and support.

examples.text: 合作安全地点已确定，请准备前往
examples.english: Cooperative security location has been identified, prepare to move

examples.text: 在合作安全地点，我们可以获得必要的支持
examples.english: At the cooperative security location, we can obtain necessary support

collocations: 获得合作安全地点的支持

terms.definitionEn: An airfield used to support tactical operations without establishing full support facilities. Also called FOB.
terms.definition: 前进作战基地是指用于支持战术行动的机场，但不会建立完整的支持设施。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and written reports for base establishment and support.

examples.text: 前进作战基地已建立，请协调空中支援
examples.english: Forward operating base has been established, coordinate air support

examples.text: 在前进作战基地，我们可以更好地支持战术行动
examples.english: At the forward operating base, we can better support tactical operations

collocations: 支持前进作战基地的行动

terms.definitionEn: A facility outside the United States and its territories with permanently stationed operating forces and robust infrastructure. Also called MOB.
terms.definition: 主要作战基地是指美国境外设有常驻作战部队和完善基础设施的设施。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and written reports for base construction and deployment.

examples.text: 主要作战基地的建设已完成
examples.english: Construction of the main operating base is complete

examples.text: 在主要作战基地，我们可以部署永久性作战力量
examples.english: At the main operating base, we can deploy permanent combat forces

collocations: 部署主要作战基地的力量

terms.definitionEn: A tailorable, temporary location used for staging forces, sustainment, and/or extraction into and out of an operational area. Also called ISB.
terms.definition: 中间停靠基地是一个可定制的临时地点，用于在作战区域内外调遣部队、维持供应和/或撤离。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications for base setup and force staging.

examples.text: 中间停靠基地已设置，请准备转移
examples.english: Intermediate staging base has been set up, prepare to transfer

examples.text: 在中间停靠基地，我们可以阶段性地调度部队
examples.english: At the intermediate staging base, we can stage forces

collocations: 调度中间停靠基地的部队

terms.definitionEn: The state of law and order prevailing within a nation.
terms.definition: 内部安全指的是一个国家内部存在的法律和秩序状况。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and written reports for security maintenance.

examples.text: 维护内部安全是我们的责任
examples.english: Maintaining internal security is our responsibility

examples.text: 内部安全受到威胁，请采取必要措施
examples.english: Internal security is under threat, take necessary measures

terms.definitionEn: All measures, active or passive, taken to counteract hostile surveillance.
terms.definition: 反侦察是指所有主动或被动采取的措施，用于对抗敌方的侦察活动。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications for surveillance countermeasures.

examples.text: 我们需要加强反侦察措施
examples.english: We need to enhance countersurveillance measures

examples.text: 反侦察小组已经就位，开始行动
examples.english: Countersurveillance team is in position, commence operation

terms.definitionEn: An activity that identifies and controls critical information and indicators of friendly force actions. Also called OPSEC.
terms.definition: 操作安全是指识别和控制友军行动的关键信息和指标的活动。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal.

examples.text: 我们必须加强操作安全，避免泄露关键信息。
examples.english: We must enhance OPSEC to prevent leakage of critical information.

examples.text: 在执行任务时，务必注意操作安全，确保行动成功。
examples.english: During mission execution, pay close attention to OPSEC to ensure success.

terms.definitionEn: Cross-functional working group whose purpose is to conduct risk assessment and risk management and to recommend mitigating measures to the commander. Also called FPWG.
terms.definition: 部队防护工作组是一个跨职能工作组，其目的是进行风险评估和风险管理，并向指挥官推荐缓解措施。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and meetings.

examples.text: 部队防护工作组将评估威胁并提出缓解措施。
examples.english: The FPWG will assess threats and recommend mitigating measures.

examples.text: 根据部队防护工作组的建议，我们加强了基地的安全防护。
examples.english: Based on FPWG recommendations, we enhanced base security.

terms.definitionEn: Defensive measures used to reduce the vulnerability of individuals and property to terrorist acts, to include rapid containment by local military and civilian forces. Also called AT.
terms.definition: 反恐怖主义是指用于减少个人和财产对恐怖主义行为的脆弱性的防御措施，包括由地方军事和民事力量进行的快速包围。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and planning.

examples.text: 反恐怖主义训练有助于提高部队应对恐怖袭击的能力。
examples.english: AT training helps improve the force's ability to respond to terrorist attacks.

examples.text: 在反恐怖主义行动中，快速封锁是关键。
examples.english: Rapid containment is crucial in AT operations.

terms.definitionEn: A Department of Defense Service or agency installation within the United States and its territories tasked to serve as a base for military forces engaged in either homeland defense or conducting defense support of civil authorities. Also called BSI.
terms.definition: 基地支援设施是指美国及其领土内的国防部服务或机构设施，任务是为从事国土防御或执行国防支持民事当局的军事力量提供基地。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and planning.

examples.text: 基地支援设施为部队提供后勤保障和维修服务。
examples.english: BSI provides logistical support and maintenance services for the troops.

examples.text: 我们需要确保基地支援设施的安全和运作。
examples.english: We must ensure the security and operation of BSI.

terms.definitionEn: In base defense operations, a locality from which operations of two or more of the Military Departments are projected or supported and which is manned by significant elements of two or more Military Departments or in which significant elements of two or more Military Departments are located.
terms.definition: 联合基地是指两个或更多军事部门的作战或支持行动的发源地或支持地点，并由两个或更多军事部门的重要部队驻扎或位于其中。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and planning.

examples.text: 联合基地促进了各军种之间的协同作战。
examples.english: Joint base promotes joint operations among services.

examples.text: 在联合基地，我们共享资源和信息。
examples.english: At the joint base, we share resources and information.

terms.definitionEn: A defense strategic intelligence assessment developed by the Defense Intelligence Agency to support combatant command planning. Also called DTA.
terms.definition: 动态威胁评估是由国防情报局开发的防御战略情报评估，用于支持作战指挥部的规划。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and planning.

examples.text: 动态威胁评估帮助指挥官制定决策。
examples.english: DTA assists commanders in decision-making.

examples.text: 定期进行动态威胁评估以应对不断变化的敌情。
examples.english: Conduct regular DTA to address evolving threats.

terms.definitionEn: The construction of obstacles and emplacement of minefields to delay, disrupt, and destroy the enemy by reinforcement of the terrain.
terms.definition: 反机动是通过构建障碍物和布设地雷场来延缓、干扰和摧毁敌人的行动。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and planning.

examples.text: 反机动措施旨在延缓和破坏敌人的行动。
examples.english: Countermobility measures aim to delay and disrupt enemy actions.

examples.text: 我们在关键路线设置反机动障碍物。
examples.english: We set up countermobility obstacles on key routes.

terms.definitionEn: Devices; systems; and associated tactics, techniques, and procedures designed, fielded, or employed unconventionally.
terms.definition: 简易威胁是指非传统设计、部署或使用的设备、系统及其相关战术、技术和程序。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and training.

examples.text: 简易威胁设备可能隐藏在普通物品中。
examples.english: Improvised threat devices may be hidden in ordinary items.

examples.text: 识别和中和简易威胁是爆炸物处理小组的任务。
examples.english: Identifying and neutralizing improvised threats is the EOD team's task.

terms.definitionEn: Preservation of the effectiveness and survivability of mission-related military and nonmilitary personnel, equipment, facilities, information, and infrastructure deployed or located within or outside the boundaries of a given operational area.
terms.definition: 防护是指保护部署在作战区域内外的军事和非军事人员、设备、设施、信息和基础设施的有效性和生存能力。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and planning.

examples.text: 防护措施确保了人员和设备的安全。
examples.english: Protection measures ensured the safety of personnel and equipment.

examples.text: 我们需要加强基地的防护以应对潜在威胁。
examples.english: We need to enhance base protection to address potential threats.

terms.definitionEn: Measures to promote, improve, or conserve the behavioral and physical well-being of Service members to enable a healthy and fit force, prevent injury and illness, and protect the force from health hazards. Also called FHP.
terms.definition: 部队健康防护是指通过促进、改善或保持军人行为和身体健康，防止伤病，并保护部队免受健康危害的措施。
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and training.

examples.text: 部队健康防护计划提高了士兵的整体健康水平。
examples.english: FHP plans improved soldiers' overall health.

examples.text: 定期进行部队健康防护培训以预防疾病。
examples.english: Conduct regular FHP training to prevent illness.

terms.definitionEn: The exercise of authority and direction by a properly designated commander over assigned and attached forces in the accomplishment of the mission. Also called C2.
terms.definition: 指挥与控制是指指挥官通过合法授权对下属部队在完成任务过程中进行的管理和指导。
terms.registerNote: Used in military briefings and reports, both written and spoken.

examples.text: 指挥与控制 (C2)系统正常运行，确保各部队协同作战。
examples.english: The C2 system is operating normally, ensuring coordinated operations among various units.

examples.text: 战斗中，指挥与控制 (C2)的效率直接影响战局。
examples.english: During combat, the efficiency of C2 directly impacts the situation.

terms.definitionEn: 1. The authority that a commander in the armed forces lawfully exercises over subordinates by virtue of rank or assignment. 2. An order given by a commander. 3. A unit or units, an organization, or an area under the authority of one individual.
terms.definition: 指挥是指军官通过军衔或任命对下属行使的合法权力。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal military communications, both radio and written.

examples.text: 指挥员下达了新的作战命令。
examples.english: The commander issued new combat orders.

examples.text: 各部队必须服从指挥，确保任务完成。
examples.english: All units must obey the command to ensure mission completion.

terms.definitionEn: 1. Authority that may be less than full command exercised by a commander over part of the activities of subordinate or other organizations. (JP 1, Volume 2) 2. In mapping, charting, and photogrammetry, a collective term for a system of marks or objects on the Earth, a map, or a photograph, whose positions or elevations (or both) have been or will be determined. (JP 2-0) 3. Physical or psychological pressures exerted with the intent to assure that an agent or group will respond as directed. (JP 3-0) 4. In intelligence usage, an indicator governing the distribution and use of documents, information, or material.
terms.definition: 控制是指指挥官对下属或其他组织部分活动行使的权力，可能不如全面指挥。
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and military reports.

examples.text: 控制塔要求飞机立即着陆。
examples.english: The control tower ordered the aircraft to land immediately.

examples.text: 我们必须保持对空域的控制。
examples.english: We must maintain control over the airspace.

terms.definitionEn: The authority to perform those functions of command over subordinate forces involving organizing and employing commands and forces, assigning tasks, designating objectives, and giving authoritative direction necessary to accomplish the mission. Also called OPCON.
terms.definition: 作战指挥权是指对下属部队进行组织和使用、分配任务、指定目标并给予必要指导以完成任务的权力。
terms.registerNote: Used in formal military communications, both radio and written.

examples.text: 作战指挥权已转移至前线指挥部。
examples.english: Operational control has been transferred to the forward command post.

examples.text: 前线部队获得了作战指挥权，可以灵活作战。
examples.english: Frontline troops have gained operational control and can fight flexibly.

terms.definitionEn: The authority over forces that is limited to the detailed direction and control of movements or maneuvers within the operational area necessary to accomplish missions or tasks assigned. Also called TACON.
terms.definition: 战术指挥权是指对部队在作战区域内进行详细指导和控制的权力，以完成分配的任务或任务。
terms.registerNote: Used in military briefings and reports, both written and spoken.
