scenarios.openerEnglish: "Our unit will be flying a surveillance drone this afternoon. We need to coordinate airspace, altitude, and timing to ensure you won't engage it. Can you provide details?"

scenarios.title: Entry control point incident with a local national
scenarios.situation: A local delivery driver arrives at the gate without a valid pass and becomes upset. Explain politely why he cannot enter, what he needs, and offer to call his contact on base.
scenarios.opener: 为什么不让我进去？我只是送货的，没有护照。你们这不是在耽误我的时间吗？
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Why won't you let me in? I'm just delivering goods, and I don't have a passport. Aren't you wasting my time?"

scenarios.title: Joint perimeter patrol brief
scenarios.situation: You lead tonight's joint perimeter patrol with host-nation soldiers. Brief their team leader on the route, check-in times, radio frequencies and what to do if you find a drone launch point.
scenarios.opener: 今晚我们将进行联合巡逻。巡逻路线、检查时间、无线电频率和发现无人机发射点时的应对措施都有哪些？
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Tonight we're conducting a joint patrol. What are the patrol route, check-in times, radio frequencies, and procedures if we find a drone launch point?"

scenarios.title: Post-incident debrief
scenarios.situation: After a night drone incursion, sit down with your host-nation counterpart to go over what happened, what worked, and what both sides will change.
scenarios.opener: 昨晚的无人机入侵事件我们需要复盘。你认为哪些方面做得好，哪些需要改进？
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Let's debrief last night's drone incursion. What do you think worked well, and what needs improvement?"

scenarios.title: Requesting a quick reaction force
scenarios.situation: Your team has found a person with a drone controller near the fence line. Call the host-nation operations center, give your location and request their quick reaction force.
scenarios.opener: 我们在围栏附近发现一个人带着无人机遥控器。请立即派遣快速反应部队到我们的位置。
scenarios.openerEnglish: "We've found someone near the fence line with a drone controller. Please dispatch your quick reaction force to our location immediately."

scenarios.title: Explaining an FPCON change to a local contractor
scenarios.situation: The force protection condition has gone up. Explain to the local construction contractor's manager what changes for his workers tomorrow: arrival times, searches and escorts.
scenarios.opener: 听说基地提高了警惕级别。明天我们工人的工作安排会有什么变化吗？
scenarios.openerEnglish: "I heard the base raised its alert level. What changes will there be for our workers' schedule tomorrow?"

scenarios.title: Coordinating a no-drone zone with municipal officials
scenarios.situation: A town festival is planned next to the base. Meet the municipal official to agree a no-drone zone notice for the public, who announces it, and how violations are handled.
scenarios.opener: 基地附近的镇上计划举办庆典。我们需要协商一个无人机禁飞区通知，并确定谁来宣布，以及如何处理违规行为。
scenarios.openerEnglish: "A town festival is planned near the base. We need to agree on a no-drone zone notice, who will announce it, and how violations will be handled."

scenarios.title: HADR drone-survey tasking
scenarios.situation: After floods, your team will fly survey drones for the host-nation disaster agency. Agree the areas, priorities, data sharing and safety rules with their coordinator.
scenarios.opener: 洪水过后，我们将派遣侦察无人机协助灾害应对。需要确定优先调查区域、数据共享和安全规则。
scenarios.openerEnglish: "After the floods, we'll be sending survey drones to assist with disaster response. We need to agree on priority areas, data sharing, and safety rules."

scenarios.title: Agreeing weapons control status with a host-nation C-UAS team
scenarios.situation: A drone swarm threat is expected tonight. Agree with the host-nation counter-drone team commander who holds engagement authority, the weapons control status, and how each side will avoid hitting friendly drones.
scenarios.opener: 今晚可能有无人机群威胁。我们需要明确谁有权进行拦截，武器控制状态，以及如何避免误伤友方无人机。
scenarios.openerEnglish: "There's a potential drone swarm threat tonight. We need to clarify who has engagement authority, the weapons control status, and how to avoid hitting friendly drones."

scenarios.title: Escorting a host-nation delegation through access control
scenarios.situation: A visiting host-nation delegation arrives for a briefing. Welcome them at the gate, explain the badge and escort rules, and walk them to the briefing room.
scenarios.partnerRole: Senior member of the visiting delegation
scenarios.opener: 欢迎来到基地。我们需要确认您的证件，并安排护送到简报室。请跟我来。
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Welcome to the base. We need to verify your credentials and arrange an escort to the briefing room. Please follow me."

lines.speaker: 观察哨哨兵 (男)
lines.text: 这里是观察哨的小李，我向您报告一个情况。
lines.english: This is Private Li from the observation post, I am reporting a situation to you.

lines.speaker: 值班军官 (女)
lines.text: 我是值班军官小王，请讲。
lines.english: This is Duty Officer Xiaowang, go ahead.

lines.speaker: 观察哨哨兵 (男)
lines.text: 发现一个多旋翼无人机在燃料点上空悬停。
lines.english: There is a small multirotor drone hovering over the fuel point.

lines.speaker: 观察哨哨兵 (男)
lines.text: 位置在燃料点西北角，距离燃料点大约五十米。
lines.english: Location is at the northwest corner of the fuel point, about fifty meters from the fuel point.

lines.speaker: 观察哨哨兵 (男)
lines.text: 无人机正在向东南方向缓慢移动。
lines.english: The drone is slowly moving to the southeast.

lines.speaker: 值班军官 (女)
lines.text: 收到，请继续监视无人机动向，并保持通报。
lines.english: Copy that, please continue to monitor the drone's movement and keep me informed.

lines.speaker: 观察哨哨兵 (男)
lines.text: 是，我正在用望远镜跟踪无人机，并记录其动向。
lines.english: Affirmative, I am tracking the drone with binoculars and recording its movement.

lines.speaker: 值班军官 (女)
lines.text: 好的，请注意安全。
lines.english: Okay, please be safe.

lines.speaker: 观察哨哨兵 (男)
lines.text: 是，完毕。
lines.english: Affirmative, over.

dialogues.title: Coordination of Drone Flight with Host-Nation Air Defense

lines.speaker: 美军空域管理员李明 (男)
lines.text: 您好，我是美军第73机动支援队的李明。请问是空军高射炮兵指挥部吗？
lines.english: Hello, this is Li Ming from the US Army's 73rd Maneuver Support Team. Am I speaking with the Air Force Air Defense Artillery Command?

lines.speaker: 解放军空军高射炮兵联络官王磊 (女)
lines.text: 您好李明同志，我是解放军空军高射炮兵联络官王磊。有什么可以帮您的吗？
lines.english: Hello Comrade Li Ming, this is Wang Lei, Air Defense Artillery Liaison Officer of the PLA Air Force. How can I assist you?

lines.speaker: 美军空域管理员李明 (男)
lines.text: 今天下午我们将在贵国领空执行无人机侦察任务，需要协调空域管制事宜。
lines.english: This afternoon, we will be conducting a surveillance drone mission in your airspace and need to coordinate airspace management.

lines.speaker: 解放军空军高射炮兵联络官王磊 (女)
lines.text: 明白了。请问您需要协调的具体空域、高度区以及时间段是哪些呢？
lines.english: Understood. Could you please specify the exact airspace, altitude block, and time frame you need to coordinate?

lines.speaker: 美军空域管理员李明 (男)
lines.text: 我们计划在贵国东部地区，从海拔100米到500米的高度区内，在14:00到16:00之间进行飞行。
lines.english: We plan to fly in the eastern region of your country, within the altitude block from 100 meters to 500 meters, between 14:00 and 16:00.

lines.speaker: 解放军空军高射炮兵联络官王磊 (女)
lines.text: 好的，我们将记录在案并通知相关部门。为了确保飞行安全，请确认无人机的型号和识别特征。
lines.english: Noted, we will record this and notify the relevant departments. To ensure flight safety, could you please confirm the model and identification features of the drone?

lines.speaker: 美军空域管理员李明 (男)
lines.text: 我们使用的无人机型号为RQ-12，具有特殊的红白相间的标识。
lines.english: We are using the RQ-12 model drone, which has a distinctive red and white markings.

lines.speaker: 解放军空军高射炮兵联络官王磊 (女)
lines.text: 感谢您的配合，李明同志。我们将确保在协调的空域和时间内不进行拦截。如果有其他问题，请随时联系我们。
lines.english: Thank you for your cooperation, Comrade Li Ming. We will ensure that no interception is conducted within the coordinated airspace and time frame. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any other questions.

lines.speaker: 美军空域管理员李明 (男)
lines.text: 非常感谢您的支持，王磊联络官。祝您工作顺利！
lines.english: Thank you very much for your support, Liaison Officer Wang Lei. Wish you a successful work!

lines.speaker: 美国空军安全部队飞行主管 李华 (男)
lines.text: 昨晚的无人机入侵事件，大家都辛苦了。我们坐下来讨论一下具体情况，看看哪些方面做得好，哪些需要改进。
lines.english: Everyone did a great job with last night's drone incursion. Let's sit down and discuss the specifics, see what worked, and what needs improvement.

lines.speaker: 解放军空军安全官员 张云 (女)
lines.text: 同意。首先，我们的探测系统在入侵初期就发现了无人机，但后来跟踪不够准确。
lines.english: Agreed. First, our detection system picked up the drone early on, but we lost accurate tracking later.

lines.speaker: 美国空军安全部队飞行主管 李华 (男)
lines.text: 是的，我们的系统也遇到了类似问题。我们可能需要更新探测软件，提高追踪精度。
lines.english: Yes, our system had similar issues. We might need to update our detection software to improve tracking accuracy.

lines.speaker: 解放军空军安全官员 张云 (女)
lines.text: 我们这边也会加强巡逻频率，确保在关键区域有更多的巡逻人员。
lines.english: We'll also increase our patrol frequency to ensure more personnel in key areas.

lines.speaker: 美国空军安全部队飞行主管 李华 (男)
lines.text: 很好。我们还需要建立更有效的通信协议，确保在事件发生时能够迅速响应。
lines.english: Good. We also need to establish more effective communication protocols to ensure a quick response when incidents occur.

lines.speaker: 解放军空军安全官员 张云 (女)
lines.text: 同意。我们可以制定一个联合响应计划，确保双方都清楚各自的职责和行动步骤。
lines.english: Agreed. We can create a joint response plan to ensure both sides know their responsibilities and actions.

lines.speaker: 美国空军安全部队飞行主管 李华 (男)
lines.text: 下一步，我们可以安排一次联合演习，测试我们的新协议和计划。
lines.english: Next, we can schedule a joint exercise to test our new protocols and plans.

lines.speaker: 解放军空军安全官员 张云 (女)
lines.text: 这个提议很好。我们会安排人员参加演习，确保一切顺利。
lines.english: That's a good idea. We'll arrange personnel to participate in the exercise to ensure everything goes smoothly.

lines.speaker: 美国巡逻队长
lines.text: 你好，我是第七小组的小张。我们在围栏附近发现了一个无人机操作员。
lines.english: Hello, this is Xiao Zhang from the 7th squad. We have found a drone operator near the fence line.

lines.speaker: 国家作战中心
lines.text: 收到，小张。请提供你们的网格坐标。
lines.english: Copy that, Xiao Zhang. Please provide your grid coordinates.

lines.speaker: 美国巡逻队长
lines.text: 我们的网格坐标是14UYD876501。请尽快派遣快速反应部队。
lines.english: Our grid coordinates are 14UYD876501. Please dispatch the quick reaction force as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: 国家作战中心
lines.text: 确认网格坐标14UYD876501。快速反应部队已出发，预计20分钟到达。
lines.english: Confirming grid coordinates 14UYD876501. The quick reaction force is en route and will arrive in approximately 20 minutes.

lines.speaker: 美国巡逻队长
lines.text: 明白了。我们将在现场保持警戒。
lines.english: Understood. We will maintain vigilance on the scene.

lines.speaker: 国家作战中心
lines.text: 收到。请保持通信畅通，如有情况变化及时报告。
lines.english: Copy that. Please keep the communication line open and report any changes in the situation promptly.

lines.speaker: 美国巡逻队长
lines.text: 好的，我们会密切监视无人机操作员位置。
lines.english: Understood, we will closely monitor the drone operator's position.

lines.speaker: 国家作战中心
lines.text: 明白。祝你们顺利。
lines.english: Understood. Good luck.

lines.speaker: 美国安保联络官（女性）
lines.text: 李经理，你好。我们的防卫保护条件今晚提高了，所以明天工人进场会有些变化。
lines.english: Manager Li, hello. Our force protection condition has been raised tonight, so there will be some changes for your workers tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 本地承包商现场经理（男性）
lines.text: 哦，是这样啊。请问具体有哪些变化呢？
lines.english: I see. Could you please tell me what the specific changes are?

lines.speaker: 美国安保联络官（女性）
lines.text: 首先，工人明天的到达时间要提前到七点钟。他们需要在车辆检查区接受安检。
lines.english: Firstly, the workers' arrival time tomorrow needs to be moved to 7:00 AM. They will need to undergo vehicle checks in the vehicle check area.

lines.speaker: 本地承包商现场经理（男性）
lines.text: 好的，我会通知所有工人提早到达。安检需要多长时间呢？
lines.english: Alright, I will inform all workers to arrive earlier. How long will the checks take?

lines.speaker: 美国安保联络官（女性）
lines.text: 每辆车大约需要十五分钟。护送人员会带领工人进入工地。他们需要随身携带工作证件。
lines.english: Each vehicle will take about fifteen minutes. Escort personnel will lead the workers into the construction site. They need to carry their work credentials with them.

lines.speaker: 本地承包商现场经理（男性）
lines.text: 明白了。护送人员是固定的人员吗？我们需要配合他们做些什么？
lines.english: Understood. Are the escort personnel fixed? What do we need to do to cooperate with them?

lines.speaker: 美国安保联络官（女性）
lines.text: 护送人员会每天早上七点在车辆检查区等候。你的工人只需要按照指示配合即可。
lines.english: The escort personnel will wait at the vehicle check area every morning at 7:00 AM. Your workers just need to follow their instructions.

lines.speaker: 本地承包商现场经理（男性）
lines.text: 好，我会确保工人都清楚明天的安排。如果有其他问题，我会再联系你。
lines.english: Alright, I will make sure the workers are clear about tomorrow's arrangements. If there are any other issues, I will contact you again.

lines.speaker: 美国安保联络官（女性）
lines.text: 好的，谢谢配合。明天见。
lines.english: Alright, thank you for your cooperation. See you tomorrow.

dialogues.title: Night Shift Change at the Base Defense Operations Center

lines.speaker: 美国基地防御指挥中心军官 (男声)
lines.text: 晚上好，王上尉。我是詹姆斯，接班来了。
lines.english: Good evening, Captain Wang. I'm James, here to take over.

lines.speaker: 中国人民解放军空军基地防御指挥中心军官 (女声)
lines.text: 晚上好，詹姆斯中尉。班次交接开始。
lines.english: Good evening, Lieutenant James. Shift change begins now.

lines.speaker: 中国人民解放军空军基地防御指挥中心军官 (女声)
lines.text: 今天晚上基地西北方向发现无人机一次，已由巡逻队跟踪并处置。
lines.english: Tonight, a drone was spotted in the northwest direction of the base. It was tracked and dealt with by a patrol.

lines.speaker: 美国基地防御指挥中心军官 (男声)
lines.text: 无人机类型和处置情况知道吗？
lines.english: Do you know the type of drone and the disposition?

lines.speaker: 中国人民解放军空军基地防御指挥中心军官 (女声)
lines.text: 初步判断为侦察型无人机，已击落。
lines.english: Initial assessment is that it was a reconnaissance drone. It has been shot down.

lines.speaker: 中国人民解放军空军基地防御指挥中心军官 (女声)
lines.text: 另外，北门摄像头出现故障，维修小组正在处理。
lines.english: Also, the camera at the north gate is malfunctioning. The maintenance team is handling it.

lines.speaker: 美国基地防御指挥中心军官 (男声)
lines.text: 明白了。巡逻队什么时候回来？
lines.english: Understood. When will the patrol team return?

lines.speaker: 中国人民解放军空军基地防御指挥中心军官 (女声)
lines.text: 预计还有一小时左右。
lines.english: Estimated to be about one hour more.

lines.speaker: 美国基地防御指挥中心军官 (男声)
lines.text: 好的，班次交接结束。我接班了。
lines.english: Understood. Shift change complete. I'm on duty now.

lines.speaker: 中国人民解放军空军基地防御指挥中心军官 (女声)
lines.text: 好的，詹姆斯中尉。有事随时联系。
lines.english: Understood, Lieutenant James. Contact me if anything happens.

lines.speaker: 哨兵（女）
lines.text: 你好！这里是空军基地的入口控制点。请问有什么可以帮您？
lines.english: Hello! This is the entrance gate to the Air Force base. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: 送货员（男）
lines.text: 我是来送货的，但他们不让我进去。我有货物需要送到仓库。
lines.english: I'm here to deliver goods, but they won't let me in. I have cargo that needs to be delivered to the warehouse.

lines.speaker: 哨兵（女）
lines.text: 很抱歉给您带来不便。根据基地规定，当地国民不能自由进入基地。您需要有效的通行证或者护送人员才能进入。
lines.english: I apologize for the inconvenience. According to base regulations, local civilians cannot enter the base freely. You need a valid pass or an escort to enter.

lines.speaker: 送货员（男）
lines.text: 什么？这太荒谬了！我经常来这里送货，从来没有遇到过这样的问题。
lines.english: What? This is ridiculous! I frequently deliver here and have never encountered such a problem before.

lines.speaker: 哨兵（女）
lines.text: 我理解您的心情，但这是基地的安全规定。您可以联系您的护送人员，或者我可以帮您打电话联系基地内部的联系人。
lines.english: I understand your feelings, but these are the base's security regulations. You can contact your escort, or I can help you call your contact inside the base.

lines.speaker: 送货员（男）
lines.text: 好的，麻烦您帮我联系一下李工程师。他的电话是138-XXXX-XXXX。
lines.english: Alright, please help me contact Engineer Li. His phone number is 138-XXXX-XXXX.

lines.speaker: 哨兵（女）
lines.text: 好的，请稍等。我现在就帮您联系。
lines.english: Alright, please hold on. I will contact him now.

lines.speaker: 哨兵（女）
lines.text: 李工程师吗？这里是入口控制点，有一位送货员需要您的协助。好的，谢谢。
lines.english: Engineer Li? This is the entrance gate, there is a delivery driver who needs your assistance. Alright, thank you.

lines.speaker: 哨兵（女）
lines.text: 李工程师已经在路上了。他很快就会来接您。再次为给您带来的不便表示歉意。
lines.english: Engineer Li is on his way. He will be here to pick you up soon. I apologize once again for the inconvenience.

lines.speaker: 送货员（男）
lines.text: 谢谢，我理解。我会等他来。
lines.english: Thank you, I understand. I will wait for him.

lines.speaker: 巡逻队长（美军女军官）
lines.text: 大家好，我是杰西卡上尉。今天晚上我们将一起进行联合巡逻。
lines.english: Hello everyone, I am Captain Jessica. Tonight we will conduct a joint patrol together.

lines.speaker: 友方队长（中国空军男军官）
lines.text: 你好，杰西卡上尉。我是李华少校，很高兴能和你们一起执行任务。
lines.english: Hello, Captain Jessica. I am Lieutenant Li Hua, and I am pleased to be able to carry out this mission with you.

lines.speaker: 巡逻队长（美军女军官）
lines.text: 李华少校，巡逻路线如下：我们从营区出发，沿着西边的山路前进，然后到达北边的山峰，最后返回营区。
lines.english: Lieutenant Li, the patrol route is as follows: we will start from the camp, proceed along the western mountain road, then reach the northern peak, and finally return to the camp.

lines.speaker: 巡逻队长（美军女军官）
lines.text: 我们需要在每小时检查点报告我们的位置。呼号是‘老虎一号’和‘老虎二号’。
lines.english: We need to report our position at hourly checkpoints. The call signs are 'Tiger One' and 'Tiger Two'.

lines.speaker: 友方队长（中国空军男军官）
lines.text: 明白了。如果我们发现无人机发射点，我们应该怎么做？
lines.english: Understood. What should we do if we find a drone launch point?

lines.speaker: 巡逻队长（美军女军官）
lines.text: 如果发现发射点，请立即报告并拍摄照片。不要接触任何可疑的装置，确保你们的安全。
lines.english: If you find a launch point, please report it immediately and take photos. Do not touch any suspicious devices and ensure your safety.

lines.speaker: 友方队长（中国空军男军官）
lines.text: 好的，我们会小心行动。有其他需要注意的事项吗？
lines.english: Okay, we will be careful. Are there any other points to note?

lines.speaker: 巡逻队长（美军女军官）
lines.text: 是的，请确保你们的通讯设备处于开启状态，频率是123.45兆赫。
lines.english: Yes, please make sure your communication devices are turned on, the frequency is 123.45 megahertz.

lines.speaker: 友方队长（中国空军男军官）
lines.text: 收到，我们会严格遵守。祝我们巡逻顺利。
lines.english: Received, we will strictly comply. Wish us a successful patrol.

lines.speaker: 巡逻队长（美军女军官）
lines.text: 谢谢，李华少校。祝我们合作愉快。
lines.english: Thank you, Lieutenant Li. Wish us a pleasant cooperation.
